name: 3SISTERS
description: Tel Aviv creative and virtual-production studio (VURT Labs Israel Ltd., Ben Avigdor St.) led by Daniel Shamota and Piotr Filatov: high-end VFX, CGI, compositing and finishing, photoreal digital humans and 3D-scanned doubles, body/face motion capture and volumetric 4D capture, and immersive VR/AR/XR experiences for brands, agencies, film and music.

name: 5IVE UX
description: Israeli UX/UI design agency based in Petah Tikva focusing on complex digital products: B2B SaaS, AI tools, enterprise, medical and defense platforms; offers UX strategy, product design and user research.

name: 94 Films
description: Israeli production company making content from social media to commercials and feature films; its reel includes Honda, Lynk & Co, Mixtiles and Schweppes and its feature 'When Clouds Fall' is in post-production (2026). ICE credits it on McCann's Apr 2026 Bank Leumi surprise-concerts campaign.

name: Abot Hameiri Communications
description: Tel Aviv TV production company founded in 2006 by Eitan Abot and Guy Hameiri (with Moti Reif), producing scripted drama such as Shtisel and Srugim and reality formats such as Survivor Israel and X Factor Israel; wholly owned by Fremantle since 2021.

name: act3
description: Israeli production company credited by ICE on McCann Tel Aviv's Aug 2026 El Al Matmid / Fly Card spot starring Deni Avdija, directed by Alon Daniel.

name: Adler Chomski & Warshavsky (Grey)
description: Israeli advertising group founded in 1996 by Reuven Adler and Eyal Chomski; it bought Warshavsky Freilich Dovev in 1998 and represents Grey in Israel. Described by Calcalist (Oct 2026) as Israel's second-largest advertising group (~400 staff), with subsidiaries including a design studio, interactive agency, sector agencies (Russian, Arab, Haredi) and LEAD. Grand Effie winner 2026 (Strauss/Doritos).
notable_clients: Discount Bank|Bezeq|Colmobil|Mifal HaPais (Lotto)|The Phoenix|Clal Insurance|Electra|Strauss (Doritos)|Delta|Shufersal (via Brickman, from Dec 2025)|Israel Discount Bank (media via MediaCom)

name: Aiode
description: Tel Aviv AI music studio offering 'virtual musicians' - instrument models trained on licensed recordings of professional players - that generate, refine and export instrument tracks into DAWs. Acquired by BandLab Technologies in July 2026; continues as a standalone product.

name: AlefAlefAlef
description: Hebrew type foundry ('house of Hebrew typography') founded in 2011 by Tel Aviv typographer Avraham Cornfeld with a group of independent designers. Publishes 40+ mostly bilingual Hebrew-Latin families and runs a Hebrew typography blog/magazine.

name: Alison.ai
description: Tel Aviv creative-intelligence platform that analyzes the visual and audio elements of ad creatives against performance data and generates new AI video ads and creative recommendations for performance marketers.

name: Altshuler Shaham
description: Israeli investment house (est. 1990 by Gilad Altshuler and Kalman Shaham) managing provident, pension and mutual funds; Tel Aviv HQ, ~1,200 employees. Being sold to the Wisor/WeSure holding group (2026).

name: Animation Israel
description: Non-profit (est. 2019) promoting the Israeli animation industry internationally: brings master classes to Israel, represents Israeli studios at markets such as Annecy and MIPCOM, lobbied for production rebates, and links Israeli animators with international service work and co-productions. Maintains a public directory of Israeli studios.

name: Animation Lab
description: Jerusalem CGI feature-animation studio founded in 2006 (with a Los Angeles presence) to make Israel's first feature-length CGI film, 'The Wild Bunch'. It closed in 2013 without releasing a finished feature.

name: Animatorit Studio
description: Herzliya boutique 2D animation studio offering design and animation for videos for any occasion and animated music clips.

name: Animix – Tel Aviv International Animation, Comics and Caricature Festival
name_he: אנימיקס – הפסטיבל הבינלאומי לאנימציה, קומיקס וקריקטורה
description: Israel's largest animation, comics and caricature festival, held every August since 2000 at the Tel Aviv Cinematheque: screenings, Israeli and international animation competitions, workshops, artist talks, industry and mingling events and a big comics market (Shukomix); ~20,000 visitors a year. The 2026 edition ran 4–8 August.

name: ANKA Studio
description: Givatayim-based veteran animation and video studio producing promotional, product, explainer, exhibition and pitch videos since 2013, combining animation with live action for corporates and tech companies.

name: Anyword
description: AI copywriting and performance-prediction platform for marketers (formerly Keywee) that generates ad, social, email and landing-page copy and scores it for predicted engagement against brand guidelines. New York / Tel Aviv.

name: Arkia Israeli Airlines
description: Israeli airline (est. 1949) flying to about 40 international destinations; expanding long-haul routes and business class in 2026.

name: Arlo Digital
description: Tel Aviv digital agency set up in October 2020 by Reuveni Pridan as an independent unit. Offers media buying, performance, social, influencer marketing, SEO/GEO, content, production, e-commerce and in-house AI tools; ICE describes it as one of Israel's fastest-growing digital firms three years running.
notable_clients: Mizrahi Tefahot|Castro|Albar|Tadiran|Novo Nordisk|University of Haifa|ORT Israel

name: Artlist
description: Israeli creative-content platform founded in 2016 that licenses royalty-free music, sound effects and stock footage (Artgrid) to video creators under subscription, and runs the Motion Array templates marketplace and FXhome video software. It reported ~$260M ARR at end-2025 and is pivoting toward an AI-native creative suite.

name: Astria
description: Tel Aviv generative-AI startup offering fine-tuning and an API for personalized image generation: AI product photoshoots and fashion lookbooks for e-commerce and professional AI headshots from reference images, with reusable photoshoot templates.

name: Atreo
description: Tel Aviv 'movement design' agency for B2B tech founded in 2012, combining category design, strategic narrative and messaging with brand identity, motion and launch campaigns.

name: Aviv Advertising
description: Full-service advertising agency in Be'er Sheva, from strategy to TV commercials, social and branding; work for Nesher, Wolt, Mahsanei HaShuk, Goldstar and Hapoel Be'er Sheva.

name: Aviv Melisron
description: Israeli residential developer (Petah Tikva), part of the Melisron/Aviv group, focused on Gush Dan and urban renewal; projects include 51 PARK Herzliya (646 units) and Aviv Givatayim (1,501 units).

name: Avraham
description: Independent Israeli advertising agency controlled by Yariv Avraham (2011 ownership: 60% Avraham, 20% Dudik Katz, 20% Nissim Moyal). Ranked No.9 in the 2023 Yifat-based agency ranking; past clients include Audi (Champion Motors) and Crowne Plaza.

name: Ayalon Insurance
description: Israeli insurance company (est. 1976, Ramat Gan HQ) that recently entered the provident-fund business; held by the WeSure (Wisor) holding group, which is buying Altshuler Shaham Finance.

name: Babushka Productions
description: Israeli production company with an in-house studio, credited by ICE on Britannia Israel's Aug 2025 campaign with Lior Raz and Eyal Berkovic and on McCann's Aug 2026 Hellmann's campaign that brought back Gary Mandelbaum from 'HaPijamot'.

name: Bank Hapoalim
description: One of Israel's two largest banks (est. 1921), with 250+ branches and a large retail-banking advertising presence; also owns digital wallet Bit.

name: Bank Leumi
description: Israel's largest bank (founded 1902 as the Anglo-Palestine Company). Its campaigns were the most frequently seen in Globes' 2025 ad index.

name: BARAM Indoor
description: Spatial branding, visual identity, signage and print division of the Baram Group (owned by Guy Baram), with an in-house studio of graphic and product designers plus print plant and workshop; redesigns offices, hospitals and schools as a one-stop design-production-installation shop.

name: Basman Tenenbaum
description: Branding and design studio in Old Jaffa founded in 1984 by Elazar Basman and Arie Tenenbaum. Builds brand identities applied across print, digital, packaging and signage, with a strong portfolio in hospitality and real estate.
notable_clients: Isrotel|Aluma Hotels & Resorts|ONYX Real Estate Developers|Raphael Hospitals|Ormat

name: Bassline Sound Design
description: Israeli sound studio credited by ICE for sound on TV campaigns including Albar with Assaf Granit (Reuveni Pridan, 2024), Migdal with Noa Tishby (Gitam BBDO, 2025) and BuyMe's Rosh Hashana campaign (Peach, 2025).

name: Bazaart
description: Tel Aviv maker of the Bazaart design app (iOS, Android, Mac, web) offering AI photo and video editing for small businesses and creators: background removal, AI product photoshoots, AI on-model shots, home staging and social/ad templates. Profitable, subscription-based.

name: BBR Saatchi & Saatchi
description: Leading Israeli advertising agency (Baumann Ber Rivnay) affiliated with Saatchi & Saatchi since 1995 and acquired by Publicis Groupe in 2012, when BBR employed 220 people. Named Globes Agency of the Year 2015; part of Publicis Groupe Israel, the country's largest communications group.

name: Beach Bum
description: Ra'anana-based mobile game developer and publisher founded in 2015 by Gigi Levy-Weiss, Uri Shahak and others, known for multiplayer board and card games such as Backgammon – Lord of the Board, Spades Royale and Gin Rummy Stars; acquired by French publisher Voodoo in 2021.

name: Bee-Creations
description: Tel Aviv branding and digital design studio founded in 2003, offering brand strategy, Hebrew corporate typeface design, packaging and wine labels, and web/app design.

name: Bezalel Academy of Arts and Design
description: Israel's national art and design academy in Jerusalem. Its Screen-Based Arts department (classical 2D, stop motion, 3D animation, video art, documentary and AR/VR) is the country's most comprehensive animation degree; Visual Communication trains much of Israel's graphic, type and motion talent. Annual graduate exhibition is a key talent-scouting event.

name: Bezeq
description: Israel's largest telecommunications group (fixed-line, fiber internet, B2B), parent of Pelephone, yes and Bezeq International. Listed on the TASE and controlled via B Communications (Searchlight).

name: BIGVU
description: Be'er Sheva-founded AI video studio for creators, realtors, coaches and marketers: teleprompter recording, AI captions and editing, AI script writing, voice cloning and 'AI twin' avatars, plus a done-for-you 'SuperAgent' video service.

name: Bilderish
description: Tel Aviv animation, video and post-production studio with 13+ years of experience making explainers, training videos, social ads, commercials and animated series for high-tech, visitor centers and gaming clients.

name: Black Sheep Film Productions
description: Israeli film and TV production company founded around 2010 by producers Saar Yogev and Naomi Levari, developing and producing features, documentaries and drama series that have premiered at Cannes, Venice, Berlin and Toronto; sister company Electric Sheep GmbH operates in Germany.

name: BlackBoard Studios
description: Israeli 3D animation, CGI and VFX studio producing product and explainer videos, commercials, in-game cinematics and exhibition content; its Nectar Sleep YouTube ad won a 2018 Webby, and it created Bazan's CGI pelican brand ambassadors.

name: Blink
description: Israeli social media agency specialising in social campaigns and interactive content, founded by Sagi Chemetz. Havas Group acquired a majority stake in August 2017, when it had 35 employees and clients such as Osem and Shufersal; it operates independently alongside Havas Inbar Merhav G.

name: Blue Monkeys Productions
description: Family-run video studio for tech and B2B brands, operating from Israel and Portugal, offering end-to-end production with live action, 2D/3D and AI-assisted animation, motion graphics and post for SaaS, cyber, fintech and gaming companies.

name: BONAMAZE
description: Tel Aviv creative and production house of drummer-producers Gilad Avnat and Stav Nahum, known for its 'Sound Of' technique — composing music from everyday sounds and cutting video to it (Tony Hawk 'The Sound of Skateboarding', Breitling). Two Sports Emmys (2023, 'NOLA Vibes' incl. audio post) and two Webbys; clients include Gitam BBDO, BBR Saatchi, Strauss, Tnuva, Teva, Wolt.
notable_clients: Breitling|Tony Hawk|Turner Sports|Gitam BBDO|BBR Saatchi & Saatchi|Strauss Group|Tnuva|Teva|Super-Pharm|Playtika|Wolt

name: Botika
description: Tel Aviv startup that uses generative AI to turn basic product photos into studio-quality on-model fashion images with AI-generated models and backgrounds, serving online clothing brands via web and an iOS app.

name: Bria
description: Israeli visual generative-AI platform for enterprises and developers, offering image (and expanding to video) generation and editing models trained on 100% licensed data, with an attribution engine that compensates content owners.

name: Brio Animation
description: Tel Aviv studio specializing in 3D CGI and AR/VR content for luxury e-commerce, notably producing content for online jewelry and diamond retailer James Allen since its early years.

name: Broadcast Media
description: Tel Aviv production and post-production company founded in 1990 by Dani Shafar and Yoav 'Chupa' Barkai, combining TV, film and commercial production with one of Israel's largest post-production operations, studio complexes in Tel Aviv and Holon, a Ramat HaHayal post branch serving ad agencies, and camera/studio rentals.

name: Brokner Yaar Levy
description: Independent Israeli advertising agency owned by Tal Brokner, Ofer Yaar and Yoram Levy (formerly Brokner Neta Yaar). Ranked No.7 in the 2023 Yifat-based agency ranking; in 2022 it bought 50% of social media agency Perfel.

name: Bunker
description: Family-owned boutique editing studio on Hashmonaim St. in Tel Aviv, run by Shiran and Sheshi Bar, providing offline and online editing and 3D animation for advertising, TV and online content, including corporate, product and event films; operating for over 12 years.

name: Burger King Israel
description: Israeli Burger King franchise, controlled by Delek Israel since 2022; ~19 restaurants with plans for 100, many at Delek fuel stations.

name: Butcher.studio
description: Boutique Tel Aviv branding, web design and development studio founded in 2021, working with startups, luxury and lifestyle brands internationally.

name: BuyMe
description: Israeli digital gift-card platform (Tel Aviv), founded around 2011–2012 by Shai Darin, Micha Berkuz and Tal Zuri; majority-owned by Teleclal since 2020. Sells gift cards to consumers and to thousands of Israeli companies.

name: Buzz Bros
description: Boutique creative production, post-production, VFX and AI studio producing commercials, branded films and animation; its site lists work for Harel, Burger King, Sprite, Yango, Isrotel, Toto, Madlan and the Ministry of Tourism. ICE credits it on Diboor's Israeli Tourism Month campaign (2025) and Burger King Israel's 'Drama King' campaign (2026).
notable_clients: Harel|Burger King|Sprite|Yango|Isrotel|Toto|Madlan|Tiv Taam|Israel Ministry of Tourism|Burger King Israel

name: Cal
description: Israeli credit-card issuer (est. 1979), owned by Discount Bank and First International Bank and being sold to Union Group and Harel (pending approval); Bnei Brak HQ, ~1,500 employees. Launched the FlyAll airline club in 2026.

name: Cameri Theatre
description: One of Israel's leading theatres, established in 1944 in Tel Aviv and housed at the Tel Aviv Performing Arts Center; Israel Prize laureate.

name: Carmi & Cohen
description: Israeli commercial production company credited by ICE on McDonald's Israel's 2024 campaign with the Mosseri brothers (Yehoshua TBWA) and on McCann work for Pepper (with creator Ido Katzir) and Wolt (2025–2026, director Assaf Harel).

name: Carolina Lemke
description: Israeli eyewear brand and store chain with Bar Refaeli as partner and face; owned by Castro Model and the Hodis group, with stores abroad in Europe, the US and Mexico.

name: Castro
description: Israeli fashion retailer (est. 1973) selling women's, men's and kids' apparel and home goods; now part of the Hodis-Castro group alongside Hodis, Top Ten and Urbanica.

name: Cellcom Israel
description: Israeli telecom operator offering mobile, fixed-line, internet and TV (Cellcom tv) services; one of the country's heaviest advertisers. Traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (CEL) and controlled by Discount Investment Corporation.

name: Central Bottling Company (Coca-Cola Israel)
description: Israel's Coca-Cola bottler (est. 1968), controlled by the Wertheim family; group also includes Neviot water, Prigat juices, Tara dairy and Israel Breweries (Carlsberg, Tuborg), and controls broadcaster Keshet.

name: Check Point Software Technologies
description: Israeli cybersecurity pioneer (founded 1993 by Gil Shwed, Marius Nacht and Shlomo Kramer), Nasdaq-listed, ~6,800 employees; produces global brand, product and event (CPX) content.

name: Cimagine Media
description: Israeli augmented-reality company (founded 2012, Kfar Yehoshua) whose tech let shoppers place 3D models of furniture and appliances in their own room via a phone or tablet camera, sold to brands and retailers. Acquired by Snap Inc. in December 2016 (reported ~$35M).

name: Clal Insurance & Finance
description: Israeli insurance and finance group (Clal Holdings) covering insurance, pensions and savings; acquired credit-card company Max in 2023.

name: Clalit Health Services
description: Israel's largest HMO (founded 1911), insuring about half the population and running hospitals and clinics nationwide.

name: Clear Cut Post Production
description: Tel Aviv video-editing and post-production agency that supplies experienced editors and post teams and runs end-to-end post for television productions and broadcasters.

name: Clinch
description: Israeli-founded agentic AI platform for omnichannel advertising ('Flight Control') that connects creative production at scale, dynamic creative optimization (DCO), ad serving and analytics across display, video, CTV, social, YouTube, DOOH and audio for brands, retailers and agencies. R&D in Israel, commercial team in New York.

name: Cloudinary
description: Image and video management platform (digital asset management, transformation, optimization and delivery APIs) used by developers and marketing teams. Founded in Israel in 2012 by Itai Lahan, Tal Lev-Ami and Nadav Soferman; major R&D in Petah Tikva, US HQ in Santa Clara. Valued at $2B in a 2022 Blackstone secondary.

name: Colmobil
description: One of Israel's largest vehicle importers, owned by the Harel family; imports Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Genesis, Mitsubishi, smart, ORA and Chery-group brands. Its ORA EV launch won the Grand Effie (2025).

name: ColoRon Post Production
description: Family-run boutique post-production studio in the Tel Aviv industrial area, founded by senior colorist Ron Ben Meir (15+ years grading features — fiction and documentary — TV series and commercials). Offers offline and online editing suites, color grading, digital mastering and delivery, dailies, backup and archive.

name: Comrax
description: Tel Aviv technology and UX company with 20+ years of experience designing and developing websites, apps and AI-based systems, with UX research and UI design as a core practice.

name: CONNECT
description: Tel Aviv digital advertising, media and technology agency, part of the Brokner Yaar Levy (BYL) advertising group. Services include media buying, social, social listening, influencer marketing, SEO/GEO and performance, with proprietary tools such as AudienceLab and GEO Radar.

name: Cowboy Productions
description: Israeli corporate animation studio operating since 2009, producing 2D and 3D brand, explainer, product, training and investor-pitch videos end to end for tech companies, public bodies and consumer brands.
notable_clients: Siemens|El Al|AudioCodes|NICE|Bright Data|Clalit|Israel Electric Corporation|Skechers Israel|Israel Ministry of Health

name: Creative Labs
description: Israeli multidisciplinary studio specialising in 'phygital architecture' and creative technology: digital installations, branded environments, responsive installations and immersive LED/real-time content for retail, hospitality and cultural spaces.

name: Crew972
description: Tel Aviv 3D animation production company founded in 2005 by Alex and Michelle Orrelle; now presented as the production company of director/animator Alex Orrelle. Credits include Wile E. Coyote and Road Runner CG segments for The Looney Tunes Show, Cartoon Network 'Nood' bumpers and the VIPO series.

name: Crystalino Group
description: Israeli import and marketing group whose brands include FAMILY air conditioners, Dreame home appliances and Swarovski.

name: CyberArk
description: Identity-security company founded in Israel in 1999 (HQ Petah Tikva). Acquired by Palo Alto Networks for ~$25B; the deal closed in February 2026.

name: D-ID
description: Tel Aviv-founded digital-human company whose Creative Reality Studio and API turn photos and text into talking-avatar videos, real-time interactive 'visual AI agents' and translated videos. Originally a face de-identification company; it powered MyHeritage's Deep Nostalgia. Acquired German explainer-video company simpleshow in September 2025.

name: Debby Group
description: Tel Aviv PR and strategic communications agency, presenting itself as an affiliate of Edelman. Offers media relations, thought leadership, events and corporate communications for tech, consumer and public clients.

name: Decart
description: Tel Aviv-based AI lab building real-time generative video and world models (Lucy live video-to-video editing, Oasis interactive world model) and a GPU optimization stack that cuts the cost of running diffusion models. Licenses its tech to platforms, advertisers and cloud providers.

name: Deepdub
description: Tel Aviv AI dubbing and voice company offering emotional text-to-speech, voice cloning and a virtual dubbing studio in 130+ languages for film/TV studios, streamers and enterprises; its work includes the Netflix film 'Every Time I Die' and a multi-series deal with Topic.

name: Delek Israel
description: One of Israel's four big fuel companies (est. 1951), running hundreds of filling stations and convenience stores (rebranded from Menta to JOE in 2022) plus fuel-logistics subsidiaries. Not Delek Motors.

name: Delek Motors
description: TASE-listed Israeli vehicle importer, controlled by Gil Agmon, distributing Mazda, Ford, BMW, MINI, BMW Motorrad and Chinese brands including NIO, Dongfeng and VOYAH.

name: Delta Galil Industries
description: Israeli apparel maker (est. 1975, Caesarea HQ) producing underwear, activewear and denim for own and licensed brands worldwide; in Israel it runs the Delta retail chain and online store. ~25,000 employees globally.

name: Design Museum Holon
description: Israel's first museum dedicated to design, opened in March 2010 in a building by Ron Arad (with Bruno Asa); exhibits historical and contemporary design, commissions and academic projects, and runs a design mediatheque.

name: Diboor
description: Tel Aviv 'social first' advertising agency (est. 2011): campaigns across TV, digital, social and influencers, plus the TikTok unit TOKS. Golden Drum Digital Agency of the Year for the AI-driven 'Listen to my Voice' campaign.

name: DISKIN
description: Experience-design company in Glil Yam (Herzliya area), active for three decades, creating visitor centers, museums, pavilions and immersive physical-digital environments with in-house design, architecture, technology and production. Work includes the Rafael and Technion visitor centers, Israel Pavilions at Expo 2010 Shanghai and Expo 2012 Yeosu, SodaStream, Strauss and Tnuva visitor centers, the Israel Police Museum and the Peres Peace library.
notable_clients: Rafael|Technion|SodaStream|Strauss|Tnuva|Intel Haifa|Israel Police|Shikun & Binui|Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Expo pavilions)

name: Docaviv - Tel Aviv International Documentary Film Festival
description: Israel's only festival dedicated to documentary film and the largest film festival in Tel Aviv, run by a non-profit founded in 1998; also holds a five-day offshoot, Docaviv Galilee, in Ma'alot-Tarshiha.

name: Dori Media Darset
description: Israeli TV development and production company led by producer Danny Paran and part of Dori Media Group, known for telenovelas, dramas and youth series such as Avoda Aravit (Arab Labor), Doctor Libby, Shababnikim and Galis.

name: Dov Abramson Studio
description: Jerusalem design studio founded in 2002 by Bezalel graduate Dov Abramson, combining design, illustration and animation. Known for work exploring contemporary Israeli and Jewish identity for cultural, educational and Jewish institutions.
notable_clients: Shalom Hartman Institute|Park Avenue Synagogue|Hebrew University|Beit Avi Chai

name: Dr. Fischer
description: Israeli pharma and cosmetics group (founded by Devora and Eli Fischer, Bnei Brak HQ, ~700 employees) making skincare, sunscreen, eye drops, hygiene products and supplements; sells in Israel and internationally.

name: Dreams & Magic
description: Israeli creative-technology and production company (active since at least 2006) producing commercials, corporate and technical videos, animation, virtual production, and immersive VR/AR experiences for hi-tech, defence, gaming and consumer brands.

name: DubiDub Studios
description: Tel Aviv Hebrew localization, dubbing and post-production studio founded by CEO Ami Offir, working since 1999 for cinema, TV, streaming/VOD and games — theatrical dubbing, Dolby Atmos mixing, metadata, title customization and visual services for Israeli platforms and global distributors.

name: Duda
description: Professional website-building platform aimed at web agencies and SaaS/hosting companies that build sites for small businesses (white-label 'website-as-a-service'). Founded in 2009 by Itai Sadan and Amir Glatt; headquartered in Palo Alto with its R&D centre in Tel Aviv.

name: Edit Studios
description: Tel Aviv post-production studio and production house operating since 1994, offering 20+ suites for offline, online, VFX, dailies and grading (Avid, Resolve, Premiere, Mistika), a DCP cinema, on-set grading and mobile 'Edit 2 Go' suites. It also hosts a post-production school staffed by JumpCut teachers and has served projects for Netflix, HBO, Apple TV, Arte and BBC.

name: Edologic
description: Israeli digital advertising agency founded in 1999 by Doron Tal, Yinon Landenberg and Amir Natan; an early mover in online video advertising (2004) and social media (2006). Became part of Publicis Groupe and was merged into its other Israeli units in 2013.

name: Eilat Tourism Corporation
description: Eilat's municipal tourism corporation, which markets the Red Sea resort city to domestic and international visitors and runs the official Eilat+ tourism site with the municipality. Ran the 'Eilat love back' winter campaign (Feb 2024) and publishes tenders for website and social-media management.

name: eko
description: Interactive video technology and content company founded in 2009 (as Interlude) by Israeli musician Yoni Bloch with Tal Zubalsky and Barak Feldman; its tools let viewers choose story paths and shoppable experiences. HQ in New York with an office in Tel Aviv; formed a joint venture with Walmart (reported $250M) in 2018.

name: El Al Israel Airlines
description: Israel's national flag carrier (est. 1948), listed on the TASE; runs the Fly Card co-branded credit card with Isracard. Its ad was voted most-liked in Globes' 2025 year-end survey.

name: Electra Consumer Products
description: Israel's market leader in air conditioning (~42% share) and a major importer and retailer of home appliances; part of the Elco group, TASE-listed.

name: Elementor
description: Israeli company behind the Elementor visual page/website builder for WordPress (launched 2016), plus managed hosting and AI site tools; it reports powering over 21 million websites. Founded by Yoni Luksenberg and Ariel Klikstein and headquartered in Ramat Gan.

name: emaze
description: Tel Aviv-based cloud presentation and visual-content platform (by Visual Software Systems Ltd.) offering templated presentations, websites, photo albums, e-cards, blogs and 3D templates, with AI features; it claims 50M+ users.

name: Entasis Visualization
description: Israeli visualization studio founded in 2008 producing photorealistic architectural, engineering and product renderings, animations, virtual tours and 3D-printed models to represent and promote projects.

name: eToro
description: Social investing platform founded in Tel Aviv in 2007, HQ Bnei Brak; IPO on Nasdaq (ETOR) in May 2025. Prolific advertiser: Super Bowl spot (2022), AI-generated Olympics ad (2024), European football and F1 sponsorships.

name: EX.CO
description: Tel Aviv publisher-video technology company, founded 2012 as interactive-content platform Playbuzz and rebranded EX.CO in 2019. Offers a video player, video CMS, livestreaming, CTV and an ML-driven monetization engine for publishers and media owners.

name: Eyeview
description: Tel Aviv-founded video-advertising technology company whose VideoIQ platform combined consumer, brand and retail data to automatically produce one-to-one personalized video ads across screens. Acquired by Aki Technologies in January 2020.

name: FINQ
description: Israeli AI-driven pension and investment house (Tel Aviv), co-founded in 2019 by Eldad Tamir (Tamir Fishman) and Nir Zuk (Palo Alto Networks); pension licence 2025, AI-run US ETFs 2026.

name: Firma
description: Israeli 'business design' and branding studio founded in 2005 in a Jaffa loft by Bezalel visual-communication alumni Doron Goldenberg and Elad Mishan. Uses its Business Core Idea (BCI) method across brand, product, culture and service.
notable_clients: Kan|The Israeli Opera|Israel Innovation Authority|Bank Leumi|Bits of Gold|Ontopo

name: Fiverr
description: Tel Aviv-headquartered online freelance-services marketplace founded in 2010, where graphic designers, video editors, animators, voice-over artists, musicians and other creatives sell services to businesses. Listed on the NYSE since 2019; in 2025 it cut ~30% of staff in a pivot to an 'AI-first' company.

name: Flow Post Production
description: Tel Aviv post-production house for TV commercials and high-end videos — retouching, cleanup, compositing and finishing. Credited as post house on the 'You're Not Alone' reservists campaign for the Ministry of Defense, IDF and Finance Ministry (LAPAM, production Market Master, Feb 2024).

name: Fontbit
description: Israeli library and foundry of professional Hebrew fonts operating since 1999, with text, book, display, bilingual and Latin families and special/custom projects.

name: Fontef Type Foundry
description: Tel Aviv type foundry established in 1994 by Yanek Iontef, designing Hebrew, Latin and Arabic typefaces. Since 2019 the exclusive distributor of Zvi Narkiss's classic Hebrew typefaces; collaborates with Commercial Type and others on Hebrew extensions (e.g. Lyon, Graphik, Canela HLAR).

name: Fontimonim
description: Hebrew font label founded by Avraham Cornfeld as a sister brand of AlefAlefAlef; each typeface is paired with an illustrated character ('FontiToon'), aimed at playful display and brand use.

name: Fontype
description: Israeli Hebrew font company for designing, developing and marketing fonts, founded in 2009 by type designer Eliyahu Freid and partner Shimon Bergman; catalogue includes Tamar, Atara, Netzach and many display faces.

name: Fox Group
description: Israeli fashion and lifestyle retail group (est. 1942 as Trico Fox) operating the Fox brand family and international franchises; traded on the TASE.

name: FreeTV
description: Israeli internet-TV service with 60+ live channels and VOD at a fixed monthly price; a joint venture of Keshet Media Group and RGE, launched to the open market in September 2023.

name: Fresh Nadlan
description: Israeli advertising agency specialising in real-estate marketing (digital, leads and project campaigns), led by CEO Tal Spivak.

name: FridayLab Studio
description: Small game-art studio acting as an outsourced art department: animation, rigging, tech art, game VFX, cinematics and game-ready assets, mainly for mobile game developers.

name: Fundbox
description: Small-business credit and payments platform founded in Israel in 2013 by Eyal Shinar, Tomer Michaeli and Yuval Ariav; HQ San Francisco with an R&D office in Tel Aviv.

name: Funkeyz Animation
description: Petah Tikva boutique studio specializing in high-quality character animation, working as an external animation team for game developers; portfolio includes work credited on Crash Bandicoot 4, Spyro Reignited Trilogy and Crash Team Rumble.

name: Gad Dairies
description: Israeli dairy producer (est. 1980) of cheeses, yogurts and desserts; listed on the TASE in Sept 2025. Its campaign won Platinum at the 2026 Effie Awards.

name: GameIS
description: Non-profit umbrella association of Israel's digital games industry (community started 2008, association formed 2011) with 7,000+ members; runs the annual GameIS conference, a grants program, community meetups, Global Game Jam Israel and a directory of Israeli games on Steam.

name: Geller Productions
description: Independent full-service production house in Rishon LeZion (founded 2017 per Production Paradise) providing production for advertising, stills and editorial shoots, TV and foreign feature films, with strong location-scouting background and crew/vendor matching.

name: Gigi Productions
description: Israeli commercial production company credited with production and editing of Electra's summer campaign starring Amir Benayoun and Lihi Kornowski, created by Adler Chomsky Warshavsky.

name: Gindi Holdings
description: One of Israel's largest private residential developers (Gindi TLV, UpperHouse, Vogue at Sde Dov); its international arm Gindi Global develops abroad, including Cyprus.

name: Gitam BBDO
description: Tel Aviv advertising agency founded in 1979 by Moshe Theumim and Yochanan Goldberg; BBDO (Omnicom) acquired a 49% stake in 1994, the first international ownership of an Israeli agency. The group includes strategic consulting arm BBDO IM and agency Pitch, and co-owns media agency OMD Israel with Yehoshua TBWA. Won the Winner sports-betting account in 2026.
notable_clients: Toto / Winner|L'Oréal Paris (Israel)|Israel Cancer Association|Fly Card (early campaign, via Pitch)|Bank Hapoalim|Winner (Israel Sports Betting Board)

name: Glickman Shamir Samsonov (Publicis)
description: Tel Aviv creative agency founded in 1987 (as Glickman Nettler Samsonov) by Hanan Glickman and partners; Publicis Groupe took a majority stake in 2015, when it had 75+ staff. Globes Agency of the Year 2013; ranked No.3 in the 2023 Yifat-based ranking and won half of the Toto account in 2026.
notable_clients: Toto (Israel Sports Betting Council)|Coca-Cola Israel|Tnuva|Partner (Orange)|El Al|FIBI (First International Bank)|Mercedes|Hyundai|Israel Post|Psagot|Yedioth Ahronoth|Peugeot|Clalit Health Services|Toto (Israel Sports Betting Board)

name: GO
description: Israeli advertising agency credited with Delek Israel's 75th-anniversary campaign (Oct 2026), an AI-assisted spot built on Mosh Ben Ari's song 'Derech', produced by Og with an in-house design and studio team.

name: Golbary
description: Israeli women's fashion chain (est. 1978) selling limited-run clothing, accessories and fragrances; HQ at Nir Zvi, ~1,000 employees, CEO Moshe Golbary. Runs presenter-led seasonal campaigns.

name: Golf & Co (Golf Group)
description: TASE-listed Israeli retail group (listed since 2006) that designs and sells apparel and home goods, best known for the Golf&Co home-design chain; it operated about 326 stores across Israel as of 2019.

name: Gong
description: Revenue AI platform for sales teams, founded in 2015 by Amit Bendov and Eilon Reshef; US HQ with its Israeli office at Icon Tower, Ramat Gan. Known for bold B2B brand campaigns.

name: Graphic Designers Association of Israel
description: Professional association of Israeli graphic designers, tracing its roots to the 1935 'Painters' Association for Applied Graphics'. Runs open calls and competitions (e.g. stamp design for its 90th year), a magazine, members' benefits club, a 'Designers for Dignity' fair-pay initiative and events; poster designer Yossi Lemel serves as its president.

name: Gravity Creative Space
description: Tel Aviv creative, design, animation and visual effects group founded in 1994 as the post-production house Gravity VFX and Design. It built a North American arm (Rhino FX, later rebranded Gravity) that worked on Hollywood features and US commercials, while the Tel Aviv studio serves Israeli and international advertising.

name: Green Productions
description: Givatayim-based production company founded in 2009 by Gal Greenspan and Roi Kurland, producing feature films, TV series and large-scale TV/digital commercials for leading Israeli ad agencies and brands, with an office in Australia. Feature credits include Scaffolding, Cinema Sabaya and Let Shuli Go.

name: Grossman TV
description: Tel Aviv VFX, post-production and color-grade boutique led by Omri Grossman. Credited as post house on Bank Discount's 2025 campaign (Adler Chomski Warshavsky, Mola Productions) and BuyMe's 2025 campaign (Peach); site work includes mobile-game spots (Bingo Blitz, Solitaire Grand Harvest, Best Fiends), Samsung Fold, Clalit and N12.

name: Gum Films
description: Production house for feature films, documentaries and TV series founded in 2008 by Sam Spiegel School graduates Yoav Roeh and Aurit Zamir, producing for Israeli and international broadcasters (Keshet, Reshet, HOT, yes, BBC, CBC, TV5); credits include the series Tell Me Everything and the documentary The Governor.

name: Gustavo Productions
description: Tel Aviv production company offering commercial production and production services (Hebrew, English, Spanish), credited as production company on Gitam BBDO's 'Their Will Your Power' spot for Beit Issie Shapiro.

name: Guts
description: Tel Aviv creative agency working with tech and consumer companies on brand and strategy, digital experiences and products.

name: H&O
description: Israeli family fashion chain (est. 1992 by HaMashbir) selling clothing for men, women and kids plus footwear, homewares, bedding and toiletries; owned by the Livnat family, ~800 employees.

name: Habima National Theatre
description: Israel's national theatre and one of the first Hebrew-language theatres, at Habima Square in Tel Aviv. Buys creative services through public tenders, including graphic-design services tenders in 2023 (10/2023) and 2024 (02/24).

name: Hafontia
description: Tel Aviv Hebrew type studio run by Ben Nathan, designing headline, text and custom brand fonts. Known for high-contrast display faces and for the Hebrew of Google's Assistant family; has made brand fonts for Keshet 12, YouTube and Eldan.

name: Hagilda
description: Tel Aviv Hebrew type foundry founded in 2002 by Bezalel graduates Michal Sahar and Danny Meirav as a cooperative platform for quality fonts; also publishes Hebrew versions of international families (e.g. Fedra Sans, Greta).

name: Haifa Municipality
description: Municipality of Israel's third-largest city and northern hub (pop. ~297,000 in 2024). Commissions city branding and campaign work; listed as a client by Haifa design studio NFH (NotFromHere).

name: Hamitham (The Complex) Post Production Facilities
description: Tel Aviv Avid-based post-production facility with dozens of editing rooms rented to TV and film productions, offering a full post service suite; Avid backed the project when it launched.

name: Hansen House – Center for Design, Media and Technology
description: Restored 19th-century compound in Jerusalem's Talbiyeh run as a center for design, media and technology: exhibitions, sound and audio-visual installations, creator residencies, the Mamuta art and research center, and home of Jerusalem Design Week.

name: Harel Insurance & Finance
description: One of Israel's largest insurance and long-term-savings groups (roots in 1935), covering insurance, pensions, health and investment products.

name: Havas Inbar Merhav G
description: Tel Aviv full-service agency founded in 1999 (Inbar Merhav G), affiliated with Havas from 2013 and acquired by Havas Group in Feb 2021. About 60 employees; runs an in-house content production unit, Studio 6 (live-action, audio, design, animation, digital), plus media and real-estate marketing departments.

name: Hebrew University of Jerusalem
description: Public research university in Jerusalem co-founded in 1918 by Albert Einstein and Chaim Weizmann. Known for out-of-home registration stunts such as a 34-metre climbing-wall billboard ('Hard, but the best', 2014) by Gefen TEAM; publishes tenders at tenders.huji.ac.il.

name: Hello.
description: Tel Aviv branding, UX/UI, product design and Webflow studio focused on B2B tech startups, with a strong cybersecurity portfolio. Work spans naming, identity, websites, event branding and motion.

name: Herzliya Studios
description: Herzliya-based, TASE-listed full-service TV production company (United Studios of Israel) offering development, production, post-production and broadcast services, studios, control rooms, multi-camera crews and OB trucks, and supplying content to international markets.

name: Hexa
description: Tel Aviv company whose AI-assisted SaaS platform converts 2D product images into interactive 3D models and AR/visual assets for e-commerce brands in furniture, fashion and electronics; started as a virtual dressing-room technology.

name: HiBob
description: HR platform 'bob' for mid-sized companies, founded in Tel Aviv in 2015 by Ronni Zehavi and Israel David; HQ in London with a large Tel Aviv office.

name: Highlight Films
description: Production services company established in 1998 by Noam Shalev, providing TV, commercial, documentary and corporate video production and fixer services for foreign crews in Israel and Palestine, with its own camera, grip and lighting equipment.

name: HIT – Holon Institute of Technology, Faculty of Design
description: Faculty of Design at the Holon Institute of Technology: B.Des. in Visual Communication, Industrial and Interior Design plus an M.Des. in Design for Technological Environment. Visual Communication has taught interactive design since 2010 and added immersive (AR/VR) design and AI across the curriculum.

name: Hiway
description: Tel Aviv company founded in 2022 that turns architectural plans into interactive, customizable 3D experiences for real-estate developers and homebuyers, including layout transformations, virtual staging, immersive 3D tours and personalized design options.

name: Hogla-Kimberly
description: Kimberly-Clark's wholly owned Israeli subsidiary and the country's largest marketer of disposable consumer goods: Huggies, Titulim, Kotex, Kleenex, Lilly.

name: HOT
description: Israeli cable TV, broadband and telecom group owned by Altice; brands include HOT cable, HOT Mobile and the NEXT TV streaming service.

name: Hour One
description: Tel Aviv / New York startup that creates AI 'virtual twins' of real people and offers Reals, a platform that turns text into presenter-led videos for business, training and marketing content.

name: Humanz
description: Tel Aviv creator-marketing platform (founded 2017) that connects brands with influencers and creators for partnership ads, UGC, affiliate commerce and advocacy programs, with audience verification and attribution. Raised $15M in Dec 2025 (total $32M) and acquired Ubiquitous and Bambassadors to expand in the US.

name: Hybrid
description: Israeli studio combining strategy, technology, design and digital marketing, formed by merging the creative studio Wicked with the technology company Quattro.

name: Icon – Tel Aviv Festival of Science Fiction, Fantasy and Role-Playing Games
description: Annual national festival of science fiction, fantasy and role-playing games, held in central Tel Aviv (Tel Aviv Cinematheque and the adjacent Eshkol HaPais complex) since 1998, during Sukkot. Hundreds of talks, panels, workshops, a cosplay competition, an Israeli indie-games area and a vendors' fair; the 2026 edition 'Wonders' ran 29 Sep – 1 Oct.

name: Direct Insurance (IDI)
description: IDI Insurance, Israel's pioneer direct insurer (operating since 1994), runs the Direct Insurance (Bituach Yashir) and Bituach 9 brands, both heavy TV advertisers.

name: Idomoo
description: Ra'anana-based personalized-video company whose AI video agent 'Lucas' and proprietary Strata model generate data-driven, personalized and interactive videos at scale for customer communications, onboarding and video ads. Traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange since 2021.

name: Igloo Creative House
description: Tel Aviv creative agency and animation studio, part of the Magic Media group, producing animated brand videos, commercials, product videos and performance-marketing creative, with a separate gaming creative arm.

name: IKEA Israel
description: Franchise operator of IKEA home-furnishing stores in Israel; a major retail advertiser.

name: Imagen
description: Tel Aviv AI post-production company whose software learns each professional photographer's personal editing style and applies it to batches of photos (Lightroom workflow), cutting culling and editing time for wedding and event photographers.

name: Inception
description: Tel Aviv immersive-content company founded in early 2016 that produced and distributed interactive VR content through its own app across Oculus, Gear VR, Daydream, Vive and mobile; raised a $15M Series A led by RTL Group in 2017.

name: InfinityAR
description: Israeli augmented-reality startup (founded 2013) that developed a software platform and SDK for AR smart glasses, for ODMs/OEMs and 3D-engine developers. Alibaba, an investor since 2016, acquired it in March 2019 and folded its R&D team into Alibaba DAMO Academy's Israel lab.

name: inManage
description: Tel Aviv software house and UI/UX studio founded in 2006, building custom e-commerce platforms, websites and native apps for large Israeli consumer brands. About 70 staff.
notable_clients: Domino's|McDonald's Israel|Aroma|HOT|Mifal HaPais|Shlomo Sixt|Azrieli Malls|Delek Ten

name: Innplay Labs
description: Tel Aviv mobile game studio formed in 2017 by developers, designers and animators, creator of Animals & Coins and known for in-house art and animation; acquired by Playtika in 2023.

name: Isracard
description: Israeli credit-card issuer and payments company (est. 1975 by Bank Hapoalim), issuing Isracard, Mastercard, Amex and co-branded cards such as El Al's Fly Card.

name: Israel AIDS Task Force
description: Israeli non-profit fighting HIV/AIDS and HIV stigma. In January 2022 it ran an anti-stigma video campaign with GSK and the Living with HIV organisation, created by the Dibur agency and directed by Rachel Bar Or.

name: Israel Cancer Association
description: Israeli non-profit for cancer prevention, research and patient support. Runs national awareness campaigns, e.g. colorectal-cancer screening campaigns with the Ministry of Health, created pro bono by Gitam BBDO (March 2024).

name: Israel Discount Bank
description: Israel's third-largest banking group (est. 1935), parent of Mercantile Bank and Cal credit cards; a top-tier TV advertiser.

name: Israel Electric Corporation
description: State-owned electric utility (est. 1923, ~99.85% government owned) responsible for Israel's grid and much of its generation.

name: Israel Film and Television Academy
description: Tel Aviv non-profit of 1,000+ film and TV professionals that runs the Ophir Awards (Israel's film awards, 34th edition in 2024) and, since 2003, the Academy Awards for Television, including a gala for behind-the-scenes professions; also produces annual Israeli film and TV catalogues for international markets and periphery screenings with Mifal HaPais.

name: Israel Ministry of Health
description: Government ministry for public health. Its public-health campaigns (e.g. HIV prevention, screening programmes) are produced through the Government Advertising Agency (LAPAM); a 2014 anti-AIDS web film was directed by Doron and Yoav Paz with Tiferet Productions.

name: Israel Ministry of Tourism
description: Government ministry (est. 1964) responsible for promoting inbound and domestic tourism, including international destination-marketing campaigns.

name: Israel Museum, Jerusalem
description: Israel's largest cultural institution (founded 1965, Givat Ram, Jerusalem): an art and archaeology museum known for its Holy Land archaeology and Jewish art collections, with roughly 800,000-900,000 visitors a year.

name: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra
description: Israel's leading symphony orchestra, founded in 1936 and based in Tel Aviv; its principal venue since 1957 is Heichal HaTarbut (Charles Bronfman Auditorium).

name: Israel Police
description: Israel's national civilian police force. Runs ongoing recruitment campaigns through LAPAM: in May 2026 the LAPAM tender committee approved ~NIS 1.69M (NIS 400K production) with Grey Content for a one-minute patrol-officer recruitment film on the 'Daka LeShmone' strip on channels 11, 12 and 13.

name: Israel Sports Betting Board (Toto / Winner)
description: Statutory body (est. 1957) operating Israel's legal sports betting under the Toto and Winner brands; ad budget of tens of millions of shekels a year.

name: The Israeli Opera
description: Israel's principal opera company, founded in 1985 and based at the Tel Aviv Performing Arts Center since 1994; also stages large outdoor productions (Israeli Opera Festival, Masada).

name: Israir
description: Israeli airline (founded 1989 as Kanfei HaEmek, renamed 1996) flying scheduled and charter routes; owned by the Rami Levy group and approved for New York flights in 2026.

name: Jelly Button Games
description: Israeli mobile game studio behind Pirate Kings, acquired by Playtika in 2017; Pirate Kings remains part of Playtika's game portfolio.

name: Jerusalem Design Week
description: Israel's largest public design event, held at Hansen House, Jerusalem, since 2011 and international since 2016: themed exhibitions, installations, talks and events. An initiative of the Ministry of Jerusalem and Heritage Affairs and the Jerusalem Development Authority, managed by Ran Wolf Ltd. The 2026 edition ('Match Point') ran 9–16 July.

name: Jerusalem Film Festival
description: Israel's main international film festival, held every summer for ten days in Jerusalem with 200+ films from about 60 countries. Established in 1984 by Lia van Leer, founder of the Jerusalem Cinematheque - Israel Film Archive, which runs it.

name: Jerusalem Municipality
description: Municipality of Israel's largest city. Buys advertising across general, Haredi/religious and Arab sectors through public tenders; its 2014 tender (est. ~NIS 4M) required branding, website and digital-campaign experience and a first ad draft within 12 hours of a brief.

name: Jiminy Creative
description: Production company (Jiminy Ltd) for TV commercials, digital campaigns, film/TV and immersive content, working with a global network of directors; its site lists work for monday.com, Papaya Global, SodaStream, Fiverr and Huawei. ICE credits it on Carolina Lemke's Oct 2025 campaign with Bar Refaeli and Yehuda Levi and on Leo Burnett's AION EV launch.

name: July-August Productions
description: Tel Aviv content development and production house established in 2004 and part of Seven.One Studios, with a format division (creator of the game show Still Standing, aired in 18 countries) and a features & drama division producing films, TV drama and documentaries, plus production services for foreign crews.

name: Jungle Sound
description: Tel Aviv audio post-production house founded in 1996 and describing itself as Israel's leading audio post company: about 14 people across ten studios on HaTehiya St., doing sound design, editing and mixing for feature films, TV content and games, for Israeli and international productions.

name: Kaltura
description: Video platform company offering enterprise video management, webinars and virtual events, education video, and cloud TV software. Founded in Israel in 2006; legal HQ in New York with main R&D in Ramat Gan. Listed on Nasdaq since July 2021; in late 2025 agreed to acquire Israeli AI-avatar startup eSelf.

name: Kan – Israeli Public Broadcasting Corporation
description: Israel's public broadcaster (on air since May 2017, replacing the IBA), running Kan 11, Makan 33, Kan Educational, eight radio stations and the Kan Box VOD service; a major commissioner of drama and documentaries.

name: Kastina Communications
description: Israeli production company established in 2005 that has produced over 300 documentaries and TV programs, plus scripted series including season 1 of Fauda (with Tender Productions), The Chef, Bloody Murray and Chanshi; documentaries include Screams Before Silence and #Nova.

name: Keren & Golan
description: Tel Aviv graphic design studio specialising in books (including culinary books), catalogues, exhibition design, visual identity, print and web design.
notable_clients: Design Museum Holon|Hadassah Academic College|Tel Aviv Municipality

name: Keshet Media Group
description: Israel's leading commercial broadcaster (est. 1993): Keshet 12, mako, N12, the freeTV streaming JV and global producer/distributor Keshet International. Controlled by Central Bottling Company.

name: Keter
description: Israeli-founded maker of resin home and garden products — outdoor furniture, storage sheds, planters and tool storage (est. 1948, Herzliya HQ); ~5,000 employees worldwide, ~2,500 in Israel; sells globally online and through retailers.

name: KNOB Music
description: Tel Aviv music and sound studio run by musicians Niv and Meital (20+ years in the industry), creating original music, covers, sonic branding, film and game scoring, voiceover and post-sound with Dolby Atmos; work includes campaigns for Playtika, SuperPlay, Samsung, Volkswagen, IKEA and KIA.

name: Koda Communications
description: Herzliya-based TV production company founded by Ram Landes (former founding editor of Channel 10 News), producing drama, documentary, reality, game shows and children's programming; formats include the reality series Connected (Machuberim), sold internationally.

name: KPLN (Kaplan)
description: Israeli creative and strategy agency founded in 2002 by Guy Boroda, with Ron Kaplan joining a year later; formerly part of the Adler Chomski group. Renamed KPLN in 2026 after Boroda's exit, led by CEO Ron Kaplan; ~35 employees, with an in-house studio & adaptation unit and performance media.

name: KSP
description: Israeli electronics and computer retail chain (est. 1994, Haifa HQ) with 74 branches as of 2026, selling computers, peripherals, consoles, phones and wider consumer goods online and in stores.

name: Kukuruza
description: Israeli commercial production company credited on Optikana's 'My personal optometrist' campaign with Noa Kirel (agency Reuveni Pridan, director Eran 'Shosho' Shpanier).

name: Label 1 Sound Design
description: Tel Aviv one-stop audio studio run by sound designer Andrey Sedich since 1998: sound design and SFX for animation and motion graphics, films, docs, commercials, promos, TV series, sound logos and games, plus mixing, Foley, dubbing/narration, voice-over recording and mastering.

name: Laila Films
description: Tel Aviv production company founded in 2010 by producer Itai Tamir, focused on independent and arthouse cinema (The Cakemaker, Red Cow, Policeman, Sharqiya, Of Dogs and Men) with 100+ festival awards; it also produced Munch's 2026 hybrid AI/live-action Arkia campaign with Lihi Toledano.

name: Israel Government Advertising Agency (LAPAM)
description: The Israeli government's in-house advertising bureau (est. 1954, independent since 1967, under the Prime Minister's Office since 2020), handling campaign creation, research and media buying for ministries, the IDF, police and other public bodies.

name: Laserbee Studio
description: Tel Aviv motion design studio (founded c. 2019) that made animated explainer and brand videos for tech companies and topped Clutch/Manifest Israeli motion-graphics rankings; it closed after six years, with its partners founding Nua Motion and Wayy Studio.

name: LEAD
description: Israeli advertising agency associated with Rami Yehudiha and reported (ICE, 2017) as part of the Adler Chomski group. Clients include Super-Pharm, Meuhedet health fund, Bank Yahav, Shlomo Sixt, Carrefour, KKL and Egged; strengthened its creative department in 2026.

name: Lemonade
description: AI-driven insurance company (renters, home, car, pet, life), founded in 2015 by Daniel Schreiber and Shai Wininger; NYSE: LMND, NYC HQ with a Tel Aviv office. Known for a playful, in-house-led brand and heavy ad spend.

name: Leo Burnett Tel Aviv
description: Tel Aviv office of the Leo Burnett network and a long-standing agency brand within Publicis Groupe Israel. Ranked No.8 in the 2023 Yifat-based Israeli agency ranking.

name: Leumit Health Services
description: Israeli health fund (est. 1933, Tel Aviv HQ, ~4,500 employees) serving members nationwide; runs humorous TV and social campaigns plus sector-targeted communications.

name: Lightricks
description: Jerusalem-based maker of creator apps Facetune, Photoleap and Videoleap and of the LTX generative-video stack: LTX Studio (AI storyboard-to-video platform) and the open-weights LTX Video / LTX-2 model (4K video with synchronized audio, open-sourced January 2026). In 2026 the company announced a split into a Facetune business and an LTX AI-video business.

name: L'Oréal Israel
description: Israeli arm of L'Oréal Group (~300 employees) marketing 22 beauty brands; HQ in Netanya with a logistics center in Caesarea. Its ~NIS 100M ad and media budget was re-tendered in 2026.

name: Maccabi Healthcare Services
description: Israel's second-largest health maintenance organization (est. 1940/41), serving roughly a quarter of the population through clinics, pharmacies and diagnostic centers.

name: Madlan
description: Israeli real-estate listings and data site competing with Yad2; moved its ~NIS 10M marketing budget to Reuveni Pridan and its digital unit Arlo in June 2026.

name: Magen David Adom
description: Israel's national emergency medical, disaster, ambulance and blood-bank service, recognised by the ICRC. Tenders its advertising: Ashkenazi Zalzman won the 2016 tender for the 'Ne'emanei Chaim' (Life Guardians) volunteer-responder campaign across TV, press, outdoor and digital.

name: Magisto
description: Ness Ziona-founded AI video editor (web and mobile) that automatically analyzed users' clips and photos and edited them into short, music-backed videos; an early consumer/SMB 'smart video' pioneer. Acquired by Vimeo in April 2019 (~$200M) and later folded into Vimeo's products.

name: MAKETHECUT
description: Tel Aviv experience studio led by designer and creative developer Or Halevi, doing branding, digital identity, web design and immersive creative development for premium brands; three Awwwards Sites of the Day.

name: Makor Foundation for Israeli Films
description: Tel Aviv non-profit film fund (founded 1995, under the Israel Film Council) financing independent documentaries and doc series, short narrative films, animated shorts and new-media works using new production and distribution technologies; runs the Makor Media stories-and-new-technologies lab.

name: Market Master
description: Israeli one-stop production company for TV commercials, corporate films, digital campaign video and animated films, handling creative and script through shoot and post; credited as production company on the government 'You Are Not Alone' campaign directed by Hagai Lapid.

name: Masterfont
description: Long-established Tel Aviv Hebrew type foundry (founded 1984 per MyFonts; 1986 per Fonts.com) owned by Piki and Zvika Rosenberg, with a large Hebrew and Latin library including the Aharoni MF family.

name: Max Stock
description: Israeli discount variety-store chain (est. 2004 by Uri Max) selling toys, stationery, tools, housewares, kitchenware, home textiles and party goods; controlled by Apax Partners and TASE-listed. ~1,900 employees (2020).

name: Max
description: Israeli credit-card and consumer-finance company (formerly Leumi Card, rebranded 2019) offering cards, loans and travel products such as Skymax; owned by Clal Holdings since 2023.

name: McCann Digital
description: Digital marketing and digital media agency in the McCann Israel group, based in Ramat HaHayal, Tel Aviv. Offers total video, content, SEM, SEO/ASO, UX/UI, programmatic and BI/data services for large advertisers.

name: McCann Tel Aviv
description: Israel's largest advertising agency by Yifat-based rankings (No.1 for about a decade). Founded 1979 as Keshet Barel; McCann-Erickson bought in from 1995 and fully owned it by 2012; renamed McCann Tel Aviv in 2014. Now under Omnicom after its IPG acquisition; the group (~500 staff) includes Universal McCann media, McCann Digital, MRM, McCann Valley and Spring Valley.
notable_clients: L'Oréal Israel|Bank Leumi|El Al|IKEA|Partner|Tnuva|MAX|Maccabi|Domino's|Tambour|Tornado|Direct Insurance (Bituah Yashir)|Yad2|Rami Levy|Wolt|Unilever|Kotex

name: McCann Valley
description: Digital/360 advertising agency in Mitzpe Ramon, founded in 2013 by McCann Tel Aviv as a business and social initiative to develop the Negev. Offers digital media, strategy, creative and account management; reports 7 Effie awards.

name: McDonald's Israel
description: McDonald's restaurant operation in Israel (first branch 1993, ~300 restaurants), long run by franchisee Aloniel; McDonald's Corp. acquired the Israeli restaurants in 2024.

name: MediaCom Israel
description: Media buying arm of the Adler Chomski group (WPP network), known as MediaCom Connections. Handles Israel Discount Bank's media (2025) and competes for large international media accounts such as Osem-Nestle.

name: Meitav Investment House
description: One of Israel's largest investment houses (roots in 1979, formerly Meitav Dash), managing provident, pension and mutual funds plus trading; Bnei Brak HQ, ~1,000 employees. Ran a David Schwimmer celebrity campaign in 2024.

name: Melio
description: B2B accounts-payable and receivable platform for small businesses, with 600+ staff in New York, Denver and Tel Aviv; acquired by Xero in 2025.

name: Menora Mivtachim
description: One of Israel's largest insurance and pension groups (roots in 1935), TASE-listed and headquartered at the Menora Mivtachim Tower in Ramat Gan; runs insurance, pension, provident and finance businesses.

name: Meuhedet
description: Israeli health fund (formed 1974 by merger; roots in 1931), HQ at HaMea Tower on Ibn Gabirol St, Tel Aviv, ~11,000 employees; competes for members with regular brand and service campaigns.

name: Mialma Production House
description: Tel Aviv commercial production house credited on 2026 TV campaigns including Bank Hapoalim's 90s-themed spot with Irena and Hila Korach (Gitam BBDO, director Assaf Harel) and Israir's tribute to Yigal Bashan (Baumann Ber Rivnai, AI work by studio T).

name: Michael Goorevich Sound Design & Mix
name_he: מיכאל גורביץ' – עיצוב פסקול ומיקס לסרטים
description: Central Tel Aviv film-sound studio with a large hybrid mixing/editing stage built to theatrical Dolby specs (4 m screen, JBL cinema monitoring): original sound design for features and TV, 5.1/7.1 film mixing and production sound, drawing on a 25-year library of self-recorded effects; credits span documentaries, features, dramas, sports and wildlife.

name: Mifal HaPais (Israel National Lottery)
description: Israel's national lottery (est. 1951) running Lotto, Chance, 777 and scratch cards; proceeds fund schools, culture halls, clinics and arts grants. Ad budget ~NIS 60M.

name: Migdal Insurance
description: Major Israeli insurance and pension group (roots in 1934) listed on the TASE, active in life, health, general insurance and long-term savings.

name: Mimezis
description: Tel Aviv creative production studio for immersive experiences (VR, AR / mixed reality) and video content for brands, artists and entertainment, handling spec, design and development end to end.

name: Mind the Gap Animation
description: Israeli animation production company 'focusing on films that make a difference'; produced the satirical post-apocalyptic web series 'Sof HaDerech' (Dead End) for Kan 11 digital, created by Nir Berger, nominated at the 2019 Israeli Academy awards.

name: Minshar for Art
description: Tel Aviv art school and cultural centre (gallery and screening hall) offering degree tracks with the Open University in film, animation, visual communication, photography, multidisciplinary art and writing, plus evening courses. Its animation track covers 2D, 3D and stop-motion; graduates feed Israeli animation and post studios.

name: Minute Media
description: Sports media and technology company (founded 2011 as 90min) that runs a publishing, video and monetization platform and owns or licenses sports brands, including digital and print rights to Sports Illustrated via a 10-year licence from Authentic Brands. HQ in London with a large Tel Aviv R&D presence; valued at over $1B in 2024.

name: Mixtiles
description: Tel Aviv consumer startup (founded 2015) whose app turns phone photos into stick-and-restick framed photo tiles and wall art, also selling canvas prints and photo books; one of Israel's fastest-growing consumer brands.

name: Mizrahi Tefahot Bank
description: Israeli bank (est. 1923) and the country's largest mortgage lender; its 2025 campaign was rated the most memorable of the year by Globes' ad index.

name: Mola Productions
description: Tel Aviv commercial production house frequently credited on major Israeli TV campaigns, e.g. for Discount Bank, Cal and Alpro (Strauss) with agency Adler Chomsky Warshavsky and director Rani Carmeli, and earlier for Pelephone (ACW Grey) and Elite (Saatchi & Saatchi Tel Aviv).

name: monday.com
description: Tel Aviv-based work-management software company (founded 2012 as DaPulse, Nasdaq: MNDY) known for heavy video-led performance and brand marketing worldwide.

name: Moon Active
description: Tel Aviv mobile game developer founded in 2011 by Samuel Albin, maker of Coin Master (which passed $6B lifetime gross revenue in 2024) and Travel Town; acquired Cyprus-based Melsoft (Family Island, My Cafe) in 2020 and was valued at $5B in a 2021 secondary round.

name: Moosh Studio
description: Tel Aviv (and NYC) studio, founded 2018, making story-driven worlds in VR, AR, games and AI installations for cultural, educational and social projects — e.g. TAMA, an AI guide for the Tel Aviv Museum of Art (with Reichman University's Advanced Reality Lab), TAZOO location-based AR for the Tel Aviv Municipality, and the 'Finding the Tools' VR resilience-training platform.
notable_clients: Tel Aviv Museum of Art|Tel Aviv Municipality|Reichman University|Geha Hospital|Shalvata Hospital

name: More Investment House
description: TASE-listed Israeli investment house (est. 2006, Ramat Gan) managing provident and study funds, pensions, portfolios and mutual funds; ~180 employees. Actress Keren Mor is its long-running presenter.

name: Moveo Group
description: Tel Aviv technology and creative group made up of specialist business units covering software development, AI and automation, creative and branding, and growth marketing, among others. Client logos include Google, Nestlé, Teva, SodaStream, Elementor, Artlist and Bank Leumi.

name: Munch
description: Independent Israeli creative agency owned by partners Yaniv Malinarsky (creative), Saar Naim (management) and Danny Chechanover (business development & digital). Clients include Cal, Naot and Goldstar; Effie Israel 2026 winner and tied for most finalists at the 2025 Granot awards.

name: Mustache Creative Studio
description: Netanya studio producing promotional videos, motion graphics and 2D/3D animation with voiceover and sound design, mainly for Israeli tech companies.

name: Muze
description: Boutique Tel Aviv product design and branding studio led by product designers Yonatan and Eyal, combining product UX, brand design and AI SaaS architecture for tech companies.

name: MV Productions (Meirav Vizer)
description: Small Israeli production-services company led by Meirav Vizer, servicing foreign commercial and stills shoots in Israel (casting through full unit management) for clients such as Optical Center, COS and Superlative; also represents TV commercial directors.

name: Natie
description: International branding agency headquartered in Tel Aviv with a distributed team (US, UK, Italy), building brands for over 20 years. Offers brand strategy, naming, identity, websites, animation and campaigns for tech, nonprofit and impact clients.
notable_clients: UBQ|IsraAID|Medisafe|Justt|Elron Ventures|The Jewish Agency|Auschwitz Jewish Center Foundation

name: National Insurance Institute (Bituach Leumi)
description: Israel's national social-security agency. Runs rights-awareness campaigns via its spokesperson's office and LAPAM, and tenders its own social-media services: Poniya Ltd. won the social-media tender and in Feb 2026 got a NIS 1.5M extension for a rehabilitation campaign for victims of hostilities.

name: Nayax
description: Cashless payments, telemetry and management platform for vending and unattended retail, founded in 2005 by Yair Nechmad and David Ben Avi; Herzliya HQ, Nasdaq/TASE: NYAX, ~1,100 employees.

name: NDG Studios
description: Israeli dubbing, subtitling and translation studio founded in 2015 by Ofir Kalfner, serving cinema distributors, broadcasters and streaming platforms with dubbing, narration, 2.0/5.1 mixes, M&E creation, DCP, SDH subtitles and sound-studio rental.

name: No, No, No, No, No, Yes
description: Creative boutique founded in 2013 by Gideon Amichay (ex-CCO of Shalmor Avnon Amichay/Y&R), first in New York and later based in Tel Aviv. Clients have included Mercedes-Benz Israel and Hyundai Israel; won Epica Gold (2025) for Calcalist's AI conference and appears in the 2023 Yifat-based top-agency ranking.

name: NFH (NotFromHere)
description: Israeli branding and positioning studio led by founder Gili Bar-Shay, offering brand strategy, packaging and unboxing design, environmental branding/wayfinding and digital design. Won first place in packaging design at the Israel Star 2022 competition for the Woojer Vest Edge package.

name: Nua Motion
description: Israeli motion design studio making brand, product and rebranding videos for tech companies; founded by former Laserbee partners.

name: Oded Ezer Design Studio
description: Typography and design studio of Israeli typographer and artist Oded Ezer (est. c. 2000), creating Hebrew and Latin typefaces, logotypes, type systems and experimental typographic work exhibited at MoMA and the V&A.

name: Og Productions
description: Israeli commercial production company credited on TV spots including Tadiran (agency Boroda Kaplan, director Rani Carmeli), Gad Dairies' 'Ray of Cheese' with chef Eyal Shani (Reuveni Pridan) and Bank Yahav (Lead Ogilvy).

name: OMD Israel
description: Media agency representing Omnicom's OMD network in Israel, owned by Gitam BBDO and Yehoshua TBWA. Led by CEO Yaniv Sana, a former Universal McCann deputy CEO who became a partner in 2025.

name: On-Air Graphics
description: Israeli broadcast graphics company providing real-time graphics for TV and web streaming: Unreal Engine virtual studios, in-studio and outdoor augmented reality, on-air graphics templates and interactive systems, with on-site support for broadcasters worldwide (e.g. election, news, sports and weather packages).

name: ONE ZERO
description: Israeli digital bank (licensed 2019, operating since 2021), founded by Marius Nacht and Prof. Amnon Shashua (now sole controller); Tel Aviv HQ, ~390 employees. Sponsored the top football league as the 'ONE ZERO League'.

name: OPEN
description: Israeli brand and UX/UI design studio founded in 2000 by Saar Friedman and Eyal Katz. Offers branding, design and advertising, with clients across fintech, tech and banking.

name: Opus Post Production
description: Founded in 1993 and describing itself as the largest post-production house in Israel, Opus provides dailies, offline and online editing, DaVinci Resolve color grading and finishing for local and international film and TV, with branches in Tel Aviv and Jerusalem. Its Digital Lab is a Dolby Vision certified facility for HDR.

name: Oron Productions
description: Tel Aviv video production house ('films that promote businesses') producing corporate, brand and product films, ads and animated films with original characters; online since at least 1999.

name: Osem-Nestlé
description: Israeli food manufacturer (est. 1942), wholly owned by Nestlé since 2016; brands include Bamba, Bissli, Osem soups and pasta, and Tivall.

name: Overwolf
description: Ramat Gan-based platform founded in 2009 that lets creators build, distribute and monetize in-game apps, overlays, mods and game servers; owns CurseForge, Tebex and Nitro, and has raised about $149M.

name: Pan Animation
description: Israeli VFX and 3D animation studio led by VFX supervisor Ariad Shiknagi, creating compositing, visual effects and 3D animation for films and TV series screened at international festivals, and 3D product/tech animations for high-tech and commerce companies. It also runs a training academy.

name: Panjaya
description: Tel Aviv startup behind BodyTalk, an AI video-dubbing platform that translates speakers into ~29 languages while preserving their voice and re-syncing lip and facial movements; TED and JFrog are reported customers.

name: Papaya Global
description: Global payroll and workforce-payments platform founded in 2016 by Eynat Guez, Ruben Drong and Ofer Herman; HQ New York with R&D in Israel, 700+ employees.

name: Parallax Virtual Production Studio
description: Tel Aviv virtual production studio using Unreal Engine environments on a high-end LED wall with OptiTrack camera tracking for TV commercials, music videos, film and television. Located in the former Israeli Television main studios in Ramat Aviv and partnered with film rental house Movie Mobile.

name: Parsman Baruch
description: Israeli advertising agency founded by Nadav Parsman (CEO) with co-owner Ram Baruch; works for ONE ZERO bank and Super-Pharm (Iroka, 2026 Effie Gold).

name: Partner Communications
description: Israeli telecom group (formerly Orange Israel) providing mobile, fiber internet and TV (Partner TV) services. Listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange; a consistent top-ranked TV advertiser.

name: Payoneer
description: Cross-border payments platform founded in 2005 by Yuval Tal, HQ in New York with a large operation in Petah Tikva, Israel; Nasdaq: PAYO.

name: Paz
description: TASE-listed Israeli fuel and retail group (est. 1958, Yakum HQ) with ~270 filling stations, the Yellow convenience chain, Super Yuda and Freshmarket supermarkets, plus EV charging and gas (Pazgaz).

name: Peach
description: Content agency of the Gitam BBDO group: branded content, original series, documentaries and music videos, TV/radio/digital integrations, influencer teams and content strategy; its Peach Agendot unit works for non-profits. Credited on Strauss's 2026 Energy campaign with Hila Saada.

name: Peanuts
description: Israeli commercial production company (credited with producer Ronen Michaeli) behind Peach's BuyMe Rosh Hashana campaign (2025) and El Al Fly Card campaign (2026) and McCann's AI-assisted Bissli campaign (2026), per ICE credits.

name: Peech
description: Tel Aviv AI video-editing platform that automatically edits talking-head and webinar footage (removing pauses and filler words), applies brand kits, adds captions and repurposes long videos into branded short clips for marketing teams.

name: Pelephone
description: Israel's first cellular operator (founded 1985 as a Motorola-Tadiran venture), now a wholly owned subsidiary of Bezeq. Shares management with sister company yes.

name: Pepper
description: Bank Leumi's mobile-only banking brand, launched as a separate digital bank and folded into Leumi's core systems from 2023; targets young customers and families with campaigns built around creators.

name: Perfect Voices
description: Tel Aviv media-services company for dubbing, voice-over, subtitling, sound and video editing in 70+ languages, running nine recording studios and two video suites for multilingual localization projects.

name: Photomyne
description: Israeli company (founded 2014) making AI-powered apps to scan and digitize old photo prints, slides and film negatives (Photo Scan by Photomyne, SlideScan, FilmBox); it reports 500M+ photos scanned. Listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange since 2021.

name: Phygital Factory
description: Herzliya creative-technology and integration studio for art exhibitions, public and commercial spaces, visitor centers, 3D video mapping, corporate events, live TV specials, concerts and national ceremonies; early adopter of LED, holograms, water screens and 360° projection, offering concept, design, interactive, sound and 2D/3D animation under one roof.

name: Pil Animation
description: Petah Tikva animation studio with 20+ years of experience producing explainer, promo, training, in-flight safety and educational videos, plus animated TV series and fillers for Israeli broadcasters and kids channels.

name: PitchiPoy Animation Productions
description: Veteran Israeli animation house founded in 1985 by Gobelins-trained animator Noam Meshulam, originally in his family's house in old Jaffa. Produces feature films, TV series and commercials in classical hand-drawn, digital 2D and 3D techniques, and has promoted a hybrid AI + 3D pipeline.

name: Pixellot
description: Petah Tikva-based provider of AI-automated sports video: unmanned multi-camera systems that capture, auto-produce, stream and generate highlights and analytics for pro, college, youth and school sports (soccer, basketball, hockey and more). Partners include Stats Perform, Red Bull Media and the Israel Football Association.
notable_clients: Israel Football Association|Stats Perform|Red Bull Media|NFHS Network

name: Plarium
description: Herzliya-headquartered mobile and PC game developer founded in 2009, known for RAID: Shadow Legends, Mech Arena and Vikings: War of Clans; acquired by Australia's Aristocrat Leisure in 2017 for $500M and employs 1,300+ across studios in Israel, Ukraine, Poland, Finland and Spain.

name: Playground
description: Israeli post-production house credited by ICE on TV campaigns for Mizrahi Tefahot (Reuveni Pridan, 2024–2026), Prigat (BBR Saatchi & Saatchi, 2024), Clalit (Glickman Shamir Samsonov, 2024) and Arkia (Munch, 2026, post and sound).

name: PlaySight
description: Israeli sports-video company (founded 2010) whose AI-powered SmartCourt camera system records, analyses and live-streams games and training across 30+ sports, used across the NBA, MLB, NHL and NCAA.
