Acquired by US connected-sports company Slinger in a share deal valued at $82M in October 2021.

name: PLAYSTUDIOS Tel Aviv
description: Tel Aviv development studio of US-listed mobile games publisher PLAYSTUDIOS (myVEGAS, POP! Slots, Tetris titles), located in the Florentin neighborhood and organized into small autonomous game teams.

name: Playtika
description: Herzliya-headquartered, Nasdaq-listed (PLTK) mobile games company founded in 2010 by Robert Antokol and Uri Shahak; portfolio includes Slotomania, Bingo Blitz, Caesars Slots, Solitaire Grand Harvest, Pirate Kings, Best Fiends, WSOP and Dice Dreams. Acquired studios include Jelly Button, Wooga, Seriously and Innplay Labs.

name: POV
description: Israeli commercial production company credited by ICE on McCann campaigns for Mey Eden (2023), Partner (2024–2025, incl. 'Harbu Darbu' with Static) and Pinuk (2026), Strauss's Milky TV spot (2025) and BBR Saatchi & Saatchi's Yotvata plant-based launch (2026).

name: Powtoon
description: Web-based platform for making animated explainer videos and presentations, founded in 2012 by Ilya Spitalnik with co-founders including Daniel Zaturansky. Formally headquartered in London but started and operating out of Tel Aviv; claims 50M+ users.

name: Prashkovsky
description: Israeli residential developer founded by Dalia and Arie Prashkovsky (group est. 1989); TASE-listed Prashkovsky Investments and Construction (Rehovot) builds in Israel and invests in US rental real estate.

name: Primus Design & Animation
description: Tel Aviv design, post-production and animation company founded in 1997, specializing in motion design, VFX, CG animation, commercials, broadcast promos and branding packages, plus original pre-school content development.

name: Programa 1 Design Studio
description: Museum and visitor-center design studio founded in 1986 by museum designer Eliav Nahlieli: heritage walk-through experiences, memorial sites and themed attractions (archaeology, Jewish and Zionist history, military museums) with architects, graphic and industrial designers and scriptwriters. THEA Awards for the Palmach Museum (2000) and the Chain of Generations Center (2007).

name: Promarket Group
description: Tel Aviv experiential-marketing and event production group (30+ years): brand experiences, corporate and marketing events, conferences, launches and incentive trips, with creative, strategy, content and production teams. Events include The Phoenix's 70th-anniversary event for 3,800 employees at Caesarea amphitheatre and a Hebrew University tribute conference for Prof. Amnon Shashua.
notable_clients: The Phoenix|Hebrew University of Jerusalem|Ashkelon Municipality

name: Promo.com
description: Tel Aviv company (started 2012 as slideshow app Slidely) offering an online video maker for businesses with licensed footage, templates for social and video ads, the PromoAI social media manager and 'ActiveCast' AI video generation with commercial rights.

name: Promotheus
description: Tel Aviv broadcast-branding and creative-tech company (~two decades) combining content, creative and an in-house R&D team: channel branding and promos, real-time and augmented-reality graphics and virtual studios for sports and TV. Work includes Red Bull Air Race, FIA WEC and Wings for Life graphics, Tour de France AR for NBC, yes rebrands and its Emmy-nominated AR Sandbox; 60+ PromaxBDA awards.

name: Publicis Tel Aviv
description: Publicis network agency in Tel Aviv (formerly Publicis Geller Nessis), one of Publicis Groupe's long-standing Israeli agency brands alongside Leo Burnett, BBR Saatchi & Saatchi and Glickman Shamir Samsonov.

name: Rabbi Interactive
description: Tel Aviv digital and technology agency producing digital products since 2005, known for interactive TV game shows, second-screen and real-time audience participation tech, AR effects and festival crowd-sync apps for media and entertainment clients.

name: Rabel Productions
description: Tel Aviv commercial production company (trading since 1995 per The Location Guide) credited on Israeli TV campaigns such as Bezeq with Adi Ashkenazi (Adler Chomsky Warshavsky) and Tapuzina (McCann), both directed by Rani Carmeli.

name: Rami Levy Hashikma Marketing
description: Israel's second-largest discount supermarket chain (est. 1976) led by founder Rami Levy; the group also runs Rami Levy Communications (mobile) and owns airline Israir.

name: Rapyd
description: Fintech-as-a-service payments platform founded in Tel Aviv in 2016 by Arik Shtilman, Arkady Karpman and Omer Priel; Israel's largest private tech company. Title sponsor of Maccabi Rapyd Tel Aviv basketball since 2025.

name: Re-Levant
description: Tel Aviv branding and graphic design studio founded in 2003 by Bezalel graduate Amnon Illuz (started in Jerusalem, moved to Tel Aviv in 2008). Works on identity, strategy, campaigns, motion, digital and curation, largely for cultural and public institutions; known for Bezalel graduation-show identities.
notable_clients: Bezalel Academy of Arts and Design|The Knesset|Batsheva Dance Company|Ashdod Port|Museum of the City

name: Reichman University
description: Israel's first private university, in Herzliya; founded in 1994 as the Interdisciplinary Center (IDC) Herzliya and recognised and renamed as a university in 2021. Markets heavily to Israeli and international students across social channels.

name: Renuar
description: Israeli fashion chain (est. 1993) selling women's and men's apparel, accessories and a home line (Renuar & More), plus the young-adult brand Twentyfourseven; about 95 points of sale and ~1,300 employees, owned by its founders.

name: Replay Technologies
description: Tel Aviv company (founded 2011) that developed freeD 'free-dimensional video', capturing live scenes as 3D data so broadcasters could render replays from any angle; used in sports broadcasts such as the YES Network's 'YES View'. Acquired by Intel in March 2016 (reported $175M).

name: Replica
description: Tel Aviv 3D motion and visualization studio on Allenby Street creating brand films, hyper-real product visuals and cinematic animation for tech, fashion, gaming and music clients.

name: Reshet 13
description: Israeli commercial TV channel (launched 2017; merged with Channel 10 in 2019). In 2026 a sale from Len Blavatnik to an investor group led by Assaf Rappaport was signed and approved by the Second Authority.

name: Reuveni Pridan
description: Tel Aviv advertising agency founded in January 1986 by Moshe Reuveni and Udi Pridan; merged into Interpublic Group in 2015 (now under Omnicom). Described by ICE (Dec 2025) as Israel's third-largest advertising group; set up independent digital agency ARLO in 2020. Effie Israel 2026 Platinum (Gad Dairies).
notable_clients: Gad Dairies|Mizrahi Tefahot Bank|Isracard|Israel Hayom|Novo Nordisk|Albar (Harley-Davidson, Triumph)|Ten Bis|Madlan|Israir|Mizrahi Tefahot|Tenbis|Harley-Davidson

name: Richkid
description: Digital experience studio based in Tel Aviv with London and New York offices, designing and building websites with UX/UI, strategy and 'technomagics' for brands and companies.

name: Riskified
description: E-commerce fraud-prevention and chargeback platform founded in 2012 by Eido Gal and Assaf Feldman; HQ in New York and Tel Aviv, NYSE: RSKD, ~770 employees (2021).

name: Riverside
description: Tel Aviv-founded recording and AI editing studio for podcasts and video: browser-based 4K local recording, text-based editor, Magic Clips short-form repurposing, AI voice/translation, captions, live streaming, webinars and podcast hosting. Founded by the Keyson brothers.

name: Sam Spiegel Film & Television School
name_he: בית הספר לקולנוע ולטלוויזיה סם שפיגל
description: Jerusalem film and television school (3 Menora St.) with directing and screenwriting tracks, extension studies and an international film lab whose projects appear at Venice and San Sebastian. Graduates' films regularly reach major festivals; a key network for Israeli directors and producers.

name: Samsung Israel
description: Samsung Electronics' Israeli marketing arm (Galaxy phones, TVs, appliances); ranked #1 in computers & mobile in the 2026 Globes Brand Index, with in-house social marketing managers since 2023.

name: Sano
description: Israeli maker of cleaning, household, paper, cosmetics and soap products (est. 1965), HQ in Hod HaSharon's Neve Ne'eman industrial zone; ~1,800 employees. A long-running TV advertiser (e.g. Sano Jet).

name: Sapir College – School of Audio and Visual Arts
name_he: המכללה האקדמית ספיר – בית הספר לאמנויות הקול והמסך
description: Film and TV school at Sapir Academic College near Sderot, known for socially engaged cinema from Israel's south. It founded and runs the Cinema South Festival (since 2001, with the Sderot Cinematheque), showing fiction, documentary, animation, TV pilots and web series from students and international filmmakers.

name: SCPG – Shortcut Playground
description: Tel Aviv design, motion and VFX house formed in 2010 by merging Shortcut (content & animation) and Playground (broadcast branding & promos for HOT). Does broadcast design, branding, commercial VFX (3D, compositing, color), experience design for museums, facades and visitor centers, and AR/VR; work includes KAN's Eurovision 2019, HOT, Amdocs, 888 and the Google Store.

name: Screen Post Productions
description: Israeli end-to-end post-production studio serving production companies, advertisers and agencies, from editing and color correction to 3D, VFX, motion graphics and AI video work. It has branches in Tel Aviv (Ramat HaHayal) and Bnei Brak, and reported about 45 employees in 2024; its site also mentions an office in Australia.

name: Session42
description: Tel Aviv AI music company founded by hit-producer brothers Oudi and Roy Antebi; builds HitCraft, an AI co-production tool that helps producers and songwriters generate song structures and variations. Produced an AI-assisted duet released for Israel's 75th Independence Day.

name: Shalmor Avnon Amichay / Y&R
description: Israeli advertising agency founded in 1989 by Rami Shalmor and Shlomi Avnon, joined by Gideon Amichay in 1994; affiliated with Young & Rubicam (WPP) from 1999 and renamed Y&R Israel in 2012. Once Israel's most-awarded agency at Cannes (19 Lions), it declined after 2012 and entered liquidation proceedings in 2021.

name: Shenkar – Engineering. Design. Art.
description: Ramat Gan college for engineering, design and art. Design schools include the School of Visual Communication, Industrial, Interior, Fashion, Textile and Jewelry Design, Multidisciplinary Art, a Master's in Design and a Master's in Digital Game Design and Development — a major source of graphic, motion and game designers.

name: SHOOF Creative Video
description: Tel Aviv-area (Givatayim) marketing-driven video studio founded in 2017, producing product, explainer and promo videos for technology brands with 2D/3D animation, live action and AI production.

name: Shoshi & Udi
description: Israeli commercial production company regularly credited by ICE on major TV campaigns, often with director Rani Carmeli: Bezeq Energy with Adi Ashkenazi (Adler Chomski & Warshavsky), El Al with Hanan Ben Ari (McCann) and Bank Leumi campaigns (McCann).

name: Shufersal
description: Israel's largest supermarket chain (est. 1958) with ~300+ stores, private labels and the Be drugstore chain; one of the country's biggest retail advertisers.

name: Shuffll
description: API-first AI video infrastructure startup that turns customer data into automated, on-brand personalized videos (membership/loyalty, real estate listings and more), orchestrating 40+ AI models for scripting, editing and personalization. Incorporated in Tel Aviv with a New York presence.

name: Similarweb
description: Digital-intelligence/web-analytics company founded in 2007 by Or Offer; HQ in New York and Givatayim, Israel; NYSE: SMWB.

name: Simply
description: Tel Aviv music-education app company (founded 2011 as JoyTunes) behind Simply Piano, Simply Guitar and Simply Sing, plus Simply Draw and Piano Maestro; it says millions of learners in 180 countries use its apps.

name: Snowball Studios
description: Tel Aviv-based 3D animation and visual effects studio founded around 2005, described as Israel's largest animation studio. Produced the 3D kids series 'VIPO: Adventures of the Flying Dog' (with Crew972) and opened a Jerusalem facility for Disney long-form work such as 'Star Darlings'.

name: SodaStream
description: Home sparkling-water maker owned by PepsiCo (acquired 2018), HQ in Kfar Saba with production in Israel; runs global and local campaigns and heavy product and social content.

name: Sound House
description: Tel Aviv audio post-production and sound-design studio on HaTa'asiya St., credited on major Israeli TV campaigns such as Cal (agency Munch, sound mix by Hudi Ben Ari) and Bank Yahav (Lead Ogilvy); team includes CEO/sound designer Yoav Sarig.

name: Sound Radix
description: Tel Aviv audio-software company founded in 2010 by Nir Averbuch, Yair Chuchem and Dan Raviv, making plug-ins for music production, mixing and audio post such as Auto-Align (multi-mic phase/time alignment), SurferEQ, Drum Leveler and Muteomatic. Auto-Align Post earned a 2020 Technical Emmy and a 2025 Sci-Tech Oscar.

name: SpectX
description: Hadera-based 3D product studio founded in 2017 by Barak Vinner, producing photorealistic product animations, exploded views, retail/POSM visualizations, VFX particles and real-time low-poly models for brands and hardware companies.

name: Sporta Digital
description: Israeli digital agency for sport: social media management, creative and design, video, campaigns and sponsorships for clubs, leagues and federations (Israel Football Association, the Winner basketball league administration, LaLiga's Hebrew channels). Designed the Israel Diamond Exchange's new logo and identity (Oct 2026), its first rebrand in about 50 years.
notable_clients: Israel Football Association|Israeli Basketball Super League administration|LaLiga (Hebrew social)|Israel Diamond Exchange|Hapoel Gilboa Galil

name: Spring Valley
description: Digital marketing agency founded in 2017 at Kibbutz Ma'oz Haim in the Spring Valley (Emek HaMaayanot) region as part of the McCann Tel Aviv group. Provides web design/development, SEO and Google Ads, social media management, branding and content.

name: Starcom Israel
description: Israeli office of Publicis Media's Starcom network, listed as one of the agency brands of Publicis Groupe Israel in 2015 and 2018 releases.

name: Strauss Group
description: Israel's largest food and beverage group (Elite, Achla, Dani, Milky, Tapuchips, Doritos/Frito-Lay license, Strauss Water) with global coffee operations. Its Doritos campaign won the 2026 Grand Effie.

name: Streetlight
description: Tel Aviv one-person design studio run by Matan Ben David, covering product UX/UI, Webflow websites and brand identity for clients worldwide; recognised with Awwwards honourable mentions.

name: Studio Aiko
description: Tel Aviv 3D and VFX studio founded in 2005 by Yair Alony and Meny Hilsenrad, producing photorealistic CG content, architectural visualization, product visualization and visual effects for TV, advertising, corporate films and games.

name: studio&more
description: Tel Aviv creative studio founded in 2016 that builds brands for technology companies, covering branding, web, product/UX, 3D and motion design.

name: Studio Animade
description: Boutique animation studio founded in 2010 and based in rural northern Israel (Kibbutz HaZorea area). Produces animated business videos, 3D product visualizations, training videos and e-learning for Israeli and international clients.

name: Animedia
description: Ramat HaSharon visual-storytelling studio producing animation of all types alongside video/green-screen production, scriptwriting, voice acting, sound design and music for brands, health organizations and startups.
notable_clients: Keshet|Israeli Football League|McDonald's Israel|Zebra Medical|Mapi Pharma|Maccabi|Assuta|Car2Go

name: Studio Chrivi Animation
description: Western Negev animation and illustration studio founded by artist-animator Ronit Zeroni (20+ years in Israeli animation studios), producing marketing and explainer animation, brand animation, character illustration, concept art and storyboards, plus independent festival films and books.

name: Studio Grin
description: Boutique color grading and finishing studio in south Tel Aviv owned and run by colorist Leon Grin, grading documentaries, independent films, commercials and corporate films, and handling conforming, transcoding, DCP creation and deliveries.

name: Studio Liran Kapel
description: Ramat Gan animation studio led by director Liran Kapel, making handcrafted brand animation that blends stop-motion, hand-drawn animation, video and mixed media for social ads, TV commercials, sponsorships and children's films.

name: Studio Pixel
description: Tel Aviv studio with 15+ years in immersive video: 2D/3D motion graphics and explainers, plus building projection-mapping shows, stage visuals, museum installations, 360 VR and AR for corporate events and brands.

name: Studio Poink
description: Tel Aviv 2D animation studio making explainer videos, motion graphics, character animation and animated commercials, focused on tech, SaaS and cybersecurity brands.

name: studio T
description: Israeli AI production studio credited with the AI work, direction (Tom Shahar) and creative direction (Tomer Tzruya) on Israir's Oct 2026 campaign honouring Yigal Bashan, made with Baumann Ber Rivnai and Mialma.

name: Studio Vida
description: Israeli architectural visualization studio founded in 2010 by interior designer and architectural photographer Yossi Orenstein, producing photorealistic architectural renderings, 3D animations and marketing videos for real-estate and product clients.

name: SundaySky
description: Founded in Israel in 2006, SundaySky is an enterprise video platform for creating, personalizing and distributing video at scale (AI Copilot script-to-video, AI avatars and voices, data-driven personalization), used mainly in financial services, insurance, healthcare and tech. Acquired by Clearhaven Partners in 2022; offices in New York, Tel Aviv and Tokyo.

name: Super-Pharm
description: Israel's largest drugstore chain (est. 1978) with 250+ stores, private labels Life and LifeStyle, and optics chain Iroka; also operates in Poland.

name: SuperPlay
description: Israeli casual mobile game studio founded in 2019 by gaming and film industry veterans, maker of Dice Dreams, Domino Dreams and Disney Solitaire; its Dice Dreams title now appears in Playtika's portfolio.

name: Sweet Sound Studios
description: Tel Aviv sound studio (Gershon Shats St.) for commercials sound design, game sound design (non-linear music, SFX, VO — clients include 888 and Playtika), game trailers, music scoring and production, radio jingles, localization and voice-over recording for TV ads and toys (Fisher-Price, Mattel).

name: Taboola
description: Content-recommendation and performance-advertising company founded in Israel in 2007 by Adam Singolda; HQ New York with major R&D in Tel Aviv; Nasdaq: TBLA (Realize platform).

name: Tailor Brands
description: AI-powered branding platform that began as an automated logo maker and expanded into an all-in-one tool for small businesses to design brand identities, websites and marketing assets and to form and run their business. HQ in New York and Tel Aviv.

name: Tara
description: Israeli dairy brand (milk, cheeses, desserts and milk drinks) owned by the Central Bottling Company (Coca-Cola Israel); launched the sugar-free Tuti Fruti milk drink in 2024.

name: The Steve Tisch School of Film and Television, Tel Aviv University
name_he: בית הספר לקולנוע וטלוויזיה ע"ש סטיב טיש, אוניברסיטת תל אביב
description: Tel Aviv University's film and TV school (Faculty of the Arts), raised to school status by Steve Tisch's $10M gift in 2015. Runs undergraduate and graduate programs incl. an English MFA in Documentary Cinema, and the TLV International Student Film Festival, founded by its students in 1986. Alumni include Oscar-shortlisted short 'Butcher's Stain'.

name: TEC Studio
description: Strategy-led Tel Aviv brand and design studio established in 2016, working with founders and marketing teams at deep tech, defense, SaaS, hospitality and impact organisations on branding, websites, pitch decks and campaigns.

name: Technion - Israel Institute of Technology
description: Israel's oldest university, a public technical research university in Haifa (established 1912, classes from 1924), with marketing, external-relations and resource-development units.

name: Tedy Productions
description: Tel Aviv TV production and artist-management company founded in 1973 by Tamira and Dodo Yardeni, creator of entertainment formats including Kochav Nolad (Israeli Idol) and HaKokhav HaBa (Rising Star, sold to ~25 countries).

name: Tel Aviv Cinematheque
description: Cinematheque and film archive opened in Tel Aviv in 1973 (HaArba'a St.), screening repertory and new cinema and hosting festivals and pitching events, including a call for pitches at its Pride film festival.

name: Tel Aviv Museum of Art
description: Modern and contemporary art museum founded in 1932, focusing on Israeli art alongside international work; campus includes the Paulson Family Foundation Building, the Herta and Paul Amir Building (2011) and the Eyal Ofer Pavilion (reopened 2023). Publishes tenders and calls on its site.

name: Tel Aviv University
description: Israel's largest public research university (founded 1956, ~30,000 students). Tenders its advertising: Zarmon DDB held the digital budget 2012-15 (NIS 1.5M in 2014) before a five-year digital tender in 2015; publishes tenders at tenders.tau.ac.il.

name: Tel Aviv-Yafo Municipality
description: Municipality of Israel's economic and cultural centre. Runs its advertising through public tenders (a NIS ~6M budget won by Adler Chomski in 2017, replacing McCann) and international tourism campaigns through its corporation 'Ir Olam ve-Tayarut' (World City & Tourism), e.g. the 2025 Pride campaign with the Ministry of Tourism.

name: Tempo Beverages
description: Israeli beer, spirits, wine and soft-drinks company; produces/distributes Goldstar beer and PepsiCo brands (Pepsi, 7UP, Mirinda), plus Barkan wines and imported waters and coffees.

name: Terminal X
description: Israeli online fashion and lifestyle retailer launched by Fox-Wizel in November 2017, selling Fox-group and international brands; TASE-listed, and in 2025 it agreed to buy 51% of Israeli jewellery and fashion brand AINKER.

name: Teva Israel
description: Israeli arm of Teva Pharmaceutical Industries (est. 1935, Tel Aviv HQ, TASE/NYSE: TEVA), selling generics, specialty and OTC medicines locally; Teva employs ~37,000 people worldwide.

name: The Bract Agency
description: Strategic branding agency for tech founders headquartered on Rothschild Boulevard, Tel Aviv, with offices in Paris and San Francisco; offers fixed-scope programmes for fundraising, launch and rebrand (brand strategy, identity, pitch decks, websites).

name: The Craft
description: Tel Aviv architectural and interior visualization studio founded in 2015, crafting high-fidelity renderings, animations and virtual experiences for hotel brands, developers, architects, interior designers and branding agencies, with projects in Israel, the US, UK and the Gulf.

name: The Hive Studio
description: Israeli animation studio founded in Tel Aviv in 2010 by producer Amit Gicelter, with branches in Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, Sderot and Athens. Develops and produces shorts, series and commercial content and original IP; produced the Oscar-nominated short 'Letter to a Pig' and the Oscar-shortlisted 'Black Slide'.

name: The Moving Company (TMC)
description: Small international 2D animation studio ('Animation That Matters') producing story-driven educational and explainer content for NGOs, universities and companies.

name: The Phoenix
description: Israeli insurance, pension and investment group offering car, home, health and life insurance, provident funds, wealth management and non-bank credit.

name: Tipalti
description: Finance-automation platform for accounts payable, global payouts and procurement, with an office in Tel Aviv; appointed a new CMO in August 2026.

name: Titan Branding
description: Herzliya-based tech-branding firm founded in 1997, providing end-to-end brand strategy, identity, web and video for technology companies, especially medical devices, mobility, semiconductors and robotics.
notable_clients: Elmo Motion Control|Sony Semiconductor Israel|Sapiens|Rivulis|Galmed|ImageSat International

name: Tiv Taam
description: Israeli supermarket chain (40+ branches, many open on Shabbat and some 24/7) and the country's largest producer and seller of non-kosher meat; TASE-listed, slogan 'the freedom to choose'.

name: Tnuva
description: Israel's largest dairy and food cooperative-turned-company (est. 1926), controlled by China's Bright Food; brands include Tnuva milk and cheeses and the plant-based Alternative line.

name: Tolstoy
description: Tel Aviv e-commerce AI platform used by thousands of Shopify brands: AI Studio turns product photos and brand guidelines into on-brand product images and videos, while its AI Player publishes shoppable video/UGC and its AI shopping agents guide buyers. Began as an interactive-video startup.

name: Tomer Biran Audio Artists
description: Boutique music and sound-design house led by Tomer Biran offering original music, sound design, music search and licensing for ads, film, TV and games, with an in-house label; one of the most-credited music producers on Israeli TV campaigns (Bezeq, Discount, Alpro) and global spots for SodaStream, Alibaba, Hyundai and monday.com.

name: Tomi House
description: Tel Aviv 3D VFX and CGI art house founded in 2018, creating digital art, 3D animation, mixed-reality and fake-out-of-home (FOOH) content and indoor/outdoor installations for brands; it also runs an academy.

name: Tonara
description: Tel Aviv music-education company (founded 2008) that began with an interactive sheet-music app that followed playing and turned pages automatically, then built Tonara Studio for tracking student practice and Tonara Connect, a teacher-student marketplace. Backed by Baidu and Carmel Ventures ($5M, 2015); reported to have ceased operations in September 2024.

name: Touch
description: Tel Aviv branding, campaign and graphic design studio producing identities, campaigns, catalogues, event design and websites, with many cultural and municipal clients.
notable_clients: Expo Tel Aviv|Tel Aviv City BID|Jerusalem City Libraries|DSV

name: Treepodia
description: Herzliya company that automatically generated personalized product videos at catalog scale for e-commerce retailers, used in product pages, loyalty video emails and targeted pre-roll ad campaigns. Reported to have ceased operations in August 2024.

name: TTV Productions
description: Tel Aviv production company creating and producing drama series, sitcoms, documentaries, doc-reality, feature films and animation for Israeli broadcasters and international networks; its live-action youth series Memory Forest won at BNFF 2022 and received an International Emmy nomination in 2023.

name: Twist Animation
description: Tel Aviv studio behind TuTiTu, a 3D-animated preschool series that became one of YouTube's most-watched kids channels (billions of views, 18 languages), and its follow-up NuNi. Co-founded by Yossi Dahan and Tal Gamliel; global rights licensed to bulbKIDZ in 2021.

name: Unilever Israel
description: Israeli subsidiary of Unilever (operating locally since 1938) with ~2,000 staff; brands include Telma, Strauss Ice Cream, Klik, Knorr, Hellmann's, Pinuk, Dove and Badin.

name: Union Media
description: Independent Israeli media planning and buying agency covering TV, digital, SEM/PPC, social, mobile, press, radio, outdoor and research, with a digital/programmatic unit (Union Head). Among the few large media buyers bidding for major accounts such as Bank Hapoalim (2025).

name: Union Motors (UMI)
description: Israeli importer of Toyota, Lexus and Geely vehicles (est. 1991 by George Horesh), part of the Horesh family's Union Group.

name: Universal McCann Israel
description: Media planning and buying agency wholly owned by McCann Tel Aviv, representing the UM network in Israel. Handles media buying for major McCann clients, including L'Oréal Israel's ~NIS 100M account retained in Oct 2026.

name: University of Haifa
description: Public research university on Mount Carmel, Haifa. Tenders its advertising and media buying (~NIS 3M a year in 2015, including student recruitment): Avraham won in 2015, replacing Yarkoni; publishes tenders at tender.haifa.ac.il.

name: Uri Amitai Productions
description: Israeli production company credited on Renoir's Passover TV commercial (agency Avraham, director Shiri Shachar, music arrangement by KNOB).

name: Vector 4
description: Tel Aviv creative production studio (Rothschild Blvd) working across four disciplines: commercials for social and TV (direction, shoot, post), generative-AI campaign assets, 3D product/environment/motion, and XR & interactive — real-time, web and experiential work.

name: Veople
description: Israeli video-marketing production office founded by director-producer Gali Harel, a former executive TV producer at Channel 10 and Keshet 12, producing branded and marketing videos; ICE credits it on Gindi Global's Feb 2026 campaign with Ron Shahar (agency Fresh Nadlan).

name: Victory
description: Israeli discount supermarket chain (est. 1986, Yavne HQ) controlled by the Ravid family, with ~68 branches and ~3,300 employees; slogan 'Ein al Victory'.

name: Videofilm International
description: Family-owned Ramat Gan dubbing and subtitling studio founded in 1981 and run by Ami and Gili Bachar, offering lip-sync dubbing, casting and directing, mix and sound editing, multi-language subtitles and DCP for clients such as Netflix, Disney, HOT and Keshet 12.

name: VideoHead
description: Israeli studio for ads, promo films and animation founded in 2010 by Itai Efrimi and Roi Katri, producing typographic and 2D animation, 3D product content, TV/digital ads and AI-generated video for government, corporate and sports clients.
notable_clients: Israel Ministry of Foreign Affairs|Israel Aerospace Industries|Clal Insurance|Bezeq|Intel|Maccabi Tel Aviv

name: Virtual Point
description: Israeli 3D medical animation studio founded by Yosi Wolfson and Kobi Rotenshtrich, producing medical device animations, pharmaceutical mechanism-of-action videos, medical training and scientific explainers, plus VR.

name: Visual3D
description: Petah Tikva studio operating since 1998 as part of the Ticomsoft Group, producing 3D product and technical films, corporate videos, training films and interactive AR/VR/web applications.

name: visualife
description: Small Tel Aviv VFX and 3D production studio offering 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, animation and rendering, green-screen filming, and post-production services such as 3D tracking, stabilization and compositing, plus VR/interactive work.

name: Vo1
description: Post-production house credited by ICE as the post house on Leo Burnett's Oct 2025 launch campaign for the AION electric-car brand starring Revital Witelson-Jacobs (production Jiminy).

name: WakingApp
description: Tel Aviv AR company (founded 2013) whose cloud platform let businesses build interactive 3D/AR experiences via drag-and-drop or JavaScript, with white-label and native-app integration, used for training, advertising, healthcare and automotive. Acquired by Scope AR in December 2019.

name: Waves Audio
description: Tel Aviv developer of professional audio plugins and signal-processing technology, founded in 1992 by Gilad Keren and Meir Shaashua; its Q10 is described as the first commercial audio plugin. Over 200 products for music production, mixing, mastering, live sound and broadcast; Technical Grammy recipient (2011).

name: WAY Studio
description: Post-production and creative studio in Rishon LeZion offering editing, VFX, 2D/3D animation, colour grading and compositing for TV commercials and music videos; ICE credits it as post house on Gitam BBDO's Bank Hapoalim campaigns (2025–2026) and Avraham's FINQ campaign (2026).

name: Wayy Studio
description: Israeli creative studio for startups offering branding, motion/brand videos, ad campaigns and websites; founded by former Laserbee partners. Work recognized by Behance features and Motion Design Awards.

name: Webydo
description: Israeli-founded cloud website-building platform for designers and web agencies (code-free editor, CMS, hosting, white-label client billing), co-founded by Shmulik Grizim and Zvika Steinmetz. The current site (Webydo Inc., Wilmington, Delaware) markets an all-in-one AI builder, store, CRM and agency platform.

name: Why Worry
description: Israeli creative agency founded by Gabi Attal; made Aviv Melisron's 51 PARK Herzliya film with Gwyneth Paltrow, shot in New York (2026).

name: Wibbitz
description: Tel Aviv AI-powered short-form video creation platform that let publishers and business teams turn text and media into branded social videos with templates and automated editing. Acquired by Vimeo in late 2021.

name: Wild Kids Animation Studio
description: Community-based animation studio in an old Jerusalem bomb shelter, started in 2010 by artists Max Epstein and the late Vasyl Sribny, where children and teens (many from Russian-speaking immigrant families) make animated films; subject of the documentary 'Wild Kids' (2018, Jerusalem Film Festival audience award).

name: Wings Games Studio
description: Israeli studio focused on extended reality (XR), AI and game development, describing itself as a metaverse design and development studio; listed with Givatayim / Tel Aviv offices.

name: Wissotzky Tea
description: Israeli-international tea company founded in Moscow in 1849 by Kalonymus Wolf Wissotzky and later based in Israel; Tel Aviv HQ (Beit Wissotzky), ~250 employees; teas, herbal infusions and coffee.

name: Wix
description: Cloud website-building platform founded in Tel Aviv in 2006, offering drag-and-drop and AI-assisted site creation, e-commerce, and the Wix Studio product for agencies and designers. Publicly traded on Nasdaq; owns the DeviantArt art community. One of Israel's largest tech employers.

name: Wochit
description: Video creation platform for publishers, brands and social teams that automates short-form/social video production from text, licensed footage and templates. Founded in Israel in 2012, with offices in New York, London and the Tel Aviv area.

name: Wolt Israel
description: Israeli arm of the Wolt food and retail delivery app (part of DoorDash), one of the country's biggest app advertisers; marketing team based in Ramat Gan.

name: WSC Sports
description: Israeli sports-tech company whose AI platform automatically creates, personalizes and distributes highlight clips and short-form content in real time for leagues, teams and broadcasters (NBA, LaLiga, DAZN, YouTube, ATP Media, NHL and others). R&D in Ramat Gan; offices in New York, London, Sydney, Tokyo and Beijing.

name: Yad2
description: Israel's largest classifieds site (founded 2005) for cars, real estate, second-hand goods and jobs; acquired by Apax from KKR in Dec 2025 (~$950M). A major TV advertiser.

name: Yashinski Studio
description: Visual effects, coding and design boutique with headquarters in Tel Aviv and Los Angeles, creating visuals for feature films, advertising and interactive experiences. It delivered 400+ VFX shots for the Israeli feature 'Image of Victory' (streaming on Netflix) and lists clients such as Coldplay, Beyoncé, Warner Bros. and HP.

name: Yehoshua TBWA
description: Tel Aviv advertising agency founded by Rami Yehoshua in 1994; TBWA (Omnicom) bought a 25% stake in 1997. Co-owns media agency OMD Israel with Gitam BBDO. Handled the Toto/Winner account 2009-2026; known for work for adidas, Maccabi, Discount Bank, LG and The North Face.
notable_clients: Assuta|adidas|Maccabi Healthcare Services|Israel Discount Bank|LG|The North Face|Toto (2009-2026)|Toyota|McDonald's|IBI|De'Longhi|Of Tov|BAT|Sugat|Bar-Ilan University|Jerusalem Municipality

name: yes Studios
description: Content sales, distribution, development and co-production arm of Israeli pay-TV provider yes, representing high-end Israeli series such as Fauda, Shtisel, The Beauty Queen of Jerusalem and Your Honor and selling finished tape and formats worldwide.

name: yes
description: Israeli satellite and streaming TV provider (yes+, yes Studios) in the Bezeq group; a commissioner of original Israeli drama alongside its marketing output.

name: Yoav Gross Productions
description: Leading Israeli scripted TV and film producer founded by Yoav Gross, holding one of Israel's largest IP libraries; series sold or remade worldwide include Red Skies (Apple TV+), Uri & Ella (HBO Max), Nehama (Canal+), HaShoter HaTov (Netflix, remade as The Good Cop) and Little Mom (remade in six territories).

name: Yochananof
description: Family-controlled Israeli supermarket chain founded by Ilana and Mordechai Yochananof as a wholesaler in the 1970s (retail since 1992); ~46 branches, holds 50.1% of discount chain Zol Stock, and trades on the TASE (TA-125).

name: YooM
description: Ramat Gan deep-tech company (formerly Tetavi) that used proprietary neural networks to capture real people as volumetric video for immersive, AR and social experiences. Raised ~$46M (Insight Partners-led $20M in 2021; Jimmy Iovine participated in 2022); reported to have ceased operations in December 2025.

name: Zed Films
description: Video production company founded in 2001 by graduates of the Jerusalem Film & Television School, producing corporate/brand films, marketing and training videos, projection-mapping shows, ceremonies and events, and offering production services in Israel.

name: Zeekit
description: Tel Aviv fashion-tech company that used computer vision and AI to render shoppers (or diverse models) wearing garments in a virtual fitting room. Acquired by Walmart in May 2021, where its tech powers 'Be Your Own Model' virtual try-on.

name: Zenith Israel
description: Israeli office of Publicis Media's Zenith network; part of the BBR Group since 1995 and listed among Publicis Groupe Israel's agency brands in 2015 and 2018. Publishes Israeli ad-spend forecasts.

name: ZOA Films
description: Israeli boutique production company and creative collective for TV commercials, digital, music videos, film and TV (One Day in October; feature Matchmaking 2), also offering production services for filming in Israel. Commercial clients include Volkswagen ID.4, FIBI, BYD and Touch; ICE credits it with production and post of Aviv Melisron's 2026 PARK51 campaign with Gwyneth Paltrow, shot in New York.
notable_clients: Volkswagen|First International Bank of Israel|BYD|Touch|Aviv Melisron
